sarvvāpadāmbhodhitaraṇi aluptaśaktidhāmne kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || khphreṁ sakalaśatrupramathani anantaśaktidhāmne astrāya kalatarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || kalaṃ nyāsa || khphreṁ namaḥ sarvvasiddhiyoginībhyaḥ pūrvavaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ namaḥ sarvasiddhi mātṛbhyo dakṣiṇavaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ namo nityoditānanda nanditāyai uttaravaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ sakalakulacakranāyikāyai paścimavaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ bhagavatyai caṇḍakāpālinyai ūrddhavaktranātha pādukāṃ || vaktranyāsa || khphreṁ paramahaṃsini sarvvajñatāśaktidhāmne hṛdayāya namaḥ || khphreṁ nirvānamārggade tṛptiśaktidhāmne śirase svāhā || khphreṁ viṣamopaplavapraśamani anādibodhaśaktidhāmne śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || khphreṁ sakaladuritāriṣṭa kleśadarani svatantraśaktidhāmne kavacāya hūṃ ||
khphreṁ sarvvāpadāmbhodhitariṇi aluptaśaktidhāmne netratrayāyai vauṣaṭ || khphreṁ sakaraśatrupramathani anantaśaktidhāmne astrāye phaṭ || ityāṅgaṃ nyāsa || taṃ bhūmadhye || dyaṁ hṛdi || thāṁ nābhau || oṃ mukhe || hrīṁ vāmanāsāpute || hūṁ dakṣanāsāpute || hāṁ vāmanetre || phreṁ dakṣanetre || kṣoṁ vāmakarṇe || kroṁ dakṣakarṇe || na liṅge || maḥ guhya || navadvāranyāsa ||

arghapātrapūjā || khphreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ arghapātrāsanāya pādukāṃ || hrīṁ

tvāṃ krūrasāṅgamahāsena saṃbhoginī ṣodaśāntāmṛtā bindusaṃdohinī syandadehaplutā śeṣa samyakparānanda nirvvāṇasaukhyaprado bhairavī bhairavodyāna krīḍānuśakte parāmārani rudramālārccite rudraśaktiḥ khagīsiddhiyogeśvarī siddhimātā vibhuḥ śabdarāśītiyoścarṇarī vā vāgviśuddhā śivā siddhavāgeśvari mātṛkāsindhamicchākriyā maṅgalā siddhalakṣmīrvvibhūtiḥ saṃbhūtirggatiḥ śāśvatākhyānti nārāyaṇī raktacaṇḍā karāle kṣaṇa || bhīmarūpā mahocchūṣmayoge priyā tvaṃ jayantyājitā rudra saṃmohinī | tvaṃ navātmākhya devasya cotsaṃgayonāśritā | mantramārggānugairmmantribhirvvīrapānānuraktaiśca subhaktai saṃpujyaso devi pañcamṛtairddivyapānāt sarvairmuṇḍakaṅkāla kāpālinī ekajanma dvijanma trijanma catuḥ pañca ṣaṭsaptajanmodbhavai
śāstavaistaiśca nāraiḥ śubhaiḥ phalguṣaistarppase madyamāsaprīyo mantravidyāvratobhāsibhirmmuṇḍakaṅkālakāpālibhirddivyacaryyānurūdairnamaskāra oṃkāra svāhā svaddhākāra vauṣaṭ vaṣaṭkāra huṃkāra phaṭkāra jāṭibhiretaiśca mantrākṣaroccāribhirvvāmahastasthitai rakta sutrā balī jāpibhiḥ sādhakaiḥ putrakaiḥrmmātṛbhirmmaṇḍalaiddīkṣitairyogibhiryyoginī vṛnda melāpakai rudrakrīḍālasaiḥ pūjya saṃyoginī yogasiddhiprade | devitvaṃ padmapatropamairllocanaiḥ snehapūrṇaistu saṃpaścase | tasya divyāntarikṣa sthitā saptapātālasaṃkhecarī siddhiravyāhatā varttate | bhaktitoyaḥ paṭheddaṇḍakanekamekakālaṃ trikālaṃ catuḥ pañca ṣaṭsaptacāṣṭau śuciḥ saṃsmaredyaḥ sadā mānavaṇ sopi caurāgni śastārṇave parvvatāgrepi saṃrajyase devi
putrānurāgān mahālakṣipriyo hemacaurānyadārānuśaktaśca brahmaghna goghna mahādoya duṣṭā vimuñcanti saṃsmṛtya devi tvadīyaṃ mukhaṃ pūrṇāndānukāriphuraddivyamāṇikya satkuṇḍalo ghṛṣṭa gaṇḍasthalaṃ | ye'pi vaddhā dṛḍhairbbandhvarnnāgapāśairbhujāvaddha pādāṃgulaistepi tvannāmasaṃkīttanāddevi muñcanti ghorairmmahāvyādhibhiḥ saṃsmṛtyapādārabindadvayaṃ te mahākāli kālāgni tejaḥ prabhe skanda brahmendra candrārkka puṣpāyudhairmmāli mālāli satpadma kiṃjalkasatpīñjare | sarvvavīrāmbike bhairavaste śaraṇāgatohaṃ kṣamasvāparādhaṃ śive ||
evaṃ stutvā mahādevī bhairavena mahātmane | tato liṅgavinirbhedya nirggatā parameśvarī ||
iti mālinīdaṇḍaka stotra samāptaḥ ||

danturo dhanadaścaiva nāgakarṇaḥ pracaṇḍavān | phetkāro vīrasiṃhaśca bhṛkuṭī meghabhāsuraḥ || yugānto rauvaścaiva lamboṣṭo vatsalastathā || śukatuṇḍaḥ ṣaḍālāsyaḥ sunāso hūhūkastathā | kṣayāntakastu pañcāśatkṣetrapālā udāhṛtāḥ || pañcāśadvarṇamuddhāre sthānasthāḥ kṣetrapālakāḥ | śeṣāvarṇavihīnāstu kṣetrapālāścaturddaśa || ekaliṅge ca huṃkāraṃ śmaśāne ca bhayāvahaṃ || mahālakṣmī vane ghore jvālāmukho vaset sadā || ekavṛkṣe vaṭa vātha viḍālavadano vasat | ghaṇṭhārā guhāvāse padmakhaṇḍe jalāmbaraḥ || saṅgame bhūridhāraughaḥ parvvate marutastathā | nirjhare śravaṇi pravāho nidhāne maṇibhadrakaḥ || rasakṣetre dhanādhyakṣo yajñavāṭeṣu kroṣṭrakaḥ | araṇye śavaravindyā dyudhāne madhukaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||

oṃ hrāṁ śāntyatītakalāyaḥ || pūrvve || oṃ hrāṁ śāntikalāya namaḥ || dakṣiṇe || oṃ hrāṁ vidyākalāya namaḥ || paścime || oṃ hrāṁ nivṛttikalāya namaḥ || uttare || oṃ hrāṁ pratiṣṭhākalāya namaḥ || ṛgvedāya idamāsanādi || vedīsthāpanaṃ || hastārghādi || vastra nīla āsanakāṣṭhopānata jalapātra pūjāpātra alaṃkālaṃ dadyāt || pūrva ṛgveda || (1) || oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ || kuśagraṃthi siruthitaya || oṃ phreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ brahmamūrttaya namaḥ || oṃ khphreṁ paramahaṃsinī hṛdayāya namaḥ || pūjana || dhūpādi || stotra || oṃ ṛgvedo mūrttimātantra indranīlasamadyuti || divyagandhānuliptāṅgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || saṃsthitaḥ pūrvvadigbhāge dīpyamānaḥ sutejasaḥ || atra gaṃdhādi ||
dakṣiṇadvāre yajurvvedīsthāpanaṃ || hastārghā ādi pūrvvavat ||
śvetavastrachatra āsanādi sarvva pūrvvavat dadyāt || oṃ siddheśvarāya nama || kuśagraṃthi sirudhitaya || oṃ siddhilakṣmī mūrttaye namaḥ || oṃ khphreṁ paramahaṃsinī hṛdayāya namaḥ || pūjana || dhūpādi || stotra || dakṣiṇepi yajurvvedaḥ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhaḥ | divyakuṇḍaladhārī ca mahākāyo mahābhujaḥ || saṃsthito dakṣiṇe bhāge yajurvveda namostute || atra gandhādi ||
paścimadvāre sāmavedīsthāpanaṃ || hastārghādi pūrvvavat || raktavastra chatra || āsanādi pūrvvavat || oṃ khphreṁ hrīṁ śivādevī aṃbā pādukāṃ || kuśagraṃthi siruthitaya || oṃ khphreṁ hrīṁ śivādevīmūrttaye namaḥ || oṃ khphreṁ paramahaṃsinī hṛdayāya namaḥ || pūjana || dhūpādi stotra ||
sthitaḥ paścimadigbhāge sāmaveda sanātanaḥ || raktāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān padmarāgabhama prabhaḥ ||
sragdāmabhūṣaṇa vipro lasallakṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || atra gaṃdhādi ||
uttare artharvvavedīsthāpanaṃ || hastārghādi pūrvvavat || kṛṣṇavastra chatra || asanādi pūrvvavat || oṃ khphreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ māyādevīmūrttaye namaḥ || oṃ khphreṁ paramahaṃsinī hṛdayāya namaḥ || pūjana || dhūpādi || stotra ||
atharvvāñjanavat śyāmaḥ sthita uttara tarastathā || piṃgākṣonāhita grīvo harikeśo mahāmuniḥ || atra gandhādi ||
caturvvedibhiḥ svasvajapastotrādikaṃ kārayat || punaḥ maṇḍapeṣu || kavaca mantreṇa pañcasūtra kusarajju pallava puṣpamālā || hṛdayanapūjanaṃ || astreṇa vajrīkaraṇaṃ || hṛdayana catuṣpathikaraṇaṃ || kavacena dvārapatha rarakṣākaraṇaṃ || maṇḍapa pratiṣṭhā || iti astādaśasaṃskāra ||
dakṣiṇabrīhi vāmarājā || madhye saṃmārjjana pūjanaṃ || oṃ hrīṁ śāntikāya astramūrttaya hūṃ phaṭ || oṃ hrīṁ puṣṭikāya lakṣmīmūrttaye hūṁ phaṭ || oṃ hreṁ sarvvāriṣṭavināśāya brahmaṇe hūṁ phaṭ ||
astrena rājāvikṣepanaṃ || arghapātraṃ gṛhītvā || śivaśaktikalaśāgratā gacchat || dakṣahastena saṃmārjjanena mārjjanaṃ || astreṇa || śivaśaktikalaśavelāsaṇapūjanaṃ || astra ṣaḍaṅgena nyāsaḥ || arghapātrādi ātmapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ calāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ calavṛṣāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ valasiṃhāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ namaste rudrarūpe hraḥ mahāpāśupatāstrāya śivāya namaḥ || evaṃ śaktaye || astra ṣaḍaṅgena pūjanaṃ || varddhanyāṃ pāśupatāstrena pūjanaṃ || dhūpa dīpa jāpa stotra || ratnoṣadhītyādi || atra gandhādi || pūrvvadvārapūjanaṃ ||
oṃ hrāṁ śāntitoraṇāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ṛgvedāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ kṛtayugāya namaḥ || śūle || oṃ hrāṁ pūṣṇa namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ dhātre namaḥ || oṃ vidhātre namaḥ || tataḥ śākhayo || oṃ hrāṁ praśāntāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śiśirāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ bhūrllokāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ bhuvalokāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ somāye nama || oṃ hrāṁ aṃgāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ avarggaḥ brahmāyaṇī nama || oṃ hrāṁ kavarggaḥ māheśvarī nama || oṃ hrāṁ pratyuṣāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ prabhāsāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ śāntikalādvārāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ īśvarādhidevatāya nama || urddhodumbāścake(?) || oṃ hrāṁ gaṇapataye nama || oṃ hrāṁ sarasvatyai nama || oṃ hrāṁ mahālakṣmī nama || tataḥ śākhā || oṃ hrāṁ nandine namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ mahākālāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ gaṃgāyai nama || oṃ hrāṁ yamunāyai nama || dhvajā || oṃ hrāṁ lūṁ vajrāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ kumudāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ
indrāya gajāsanāya nama || kalaśa dhyānaṃ || airāvatasamārūḍhaṃ vajrahastaṃ suśobhanaṃ || pītāruṇanibhaṃ dehamādvayāmi sacīpatiṃ ||
oṃ hrāṁ lūṁ indrāya nama || bali || oṃ hrāṁ prayāgahetvaśitāṅgebhyaḥ baliṃ gṛha (2) svāhā || dhūpādi stutyantaṃ || namostute sacīpate pūrvvādhipatayaśvara | yajñayājñeṣu karmmāṇi rakṣārthaṃ sanidhirbhava || atra gandhādi || agre(?) || oṃ riddhitoranāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ riddhidvārāya nama || khaḍiravṛkṣāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ agnayecchāgāsanāya namaḥ || kalaśadhyānaṃ || chāgapṛṣṭhāsana devaśaktihasto mahābala || raktavarṇa sutejāṅgaṃ vaiśvānalaṃ namāmyahaṃ ||
oṃ hrāṁ rūṁ agnaya namaḥ || dhvajā || oṃ hrāṁ rūṁ śaktaye phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ kumudākṣāya nama || bali || oṃ hrāṁ varuṇa tripurāntaka rurubhyaḥ baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādi stutyantaṃ ||
namo'stute saptarvviṣe āgneyādhipateśvare | yajñapālayate naiva rakṣārthaṃ sannidhirbhava || atra gandhādi ||
dakṣinadvāra || oṃ hrāṁ bhūtitoraṇāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ yajurvvedāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ tretāyugāya nama || śūle || oṃ hrāṁ ugrāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ indave nama || oṃ hrāṁ argha (*)(?) nama || śākhā || oṃ hrāṁ pradyumne nama || oṃ hrāṁ aśvakāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ svarllokāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ maharllokāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ budhāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ bṛhaspataye namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ cavargge komārī nama || oṃ hrāṁ ṭavargge vaiṣṇavī namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ajaghanyāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ jaghanyāye nama ||
dvāre || oṃ hrāṁ vidyākalāye dvārāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ rudrāyādhidevatāya nama || ūrddheduṃ bali || oṃ hrāṁ gaṇapataye namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sarasvatyai nama || oṃ hrāṁ lakṣmyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ bhṛṃgi namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vināyakāya namaḥ ||
oṃ hrāṁ mahyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ narmmadāyai namaḥ ||
dhvajā || oṃ hrāṁ mū daṇḍāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ puṇḍalīkāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ yamāya mahiṣāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || mahiṣāsanamārūḍhaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ tu śobhanaṃ || kṛṣṇāñjananibhaṃ dehaṃ dharmmarājāpate namaḥ || hrāṁ oṃ muṃ yamāya namaḥ ||
bali || oṃ hrāṁ kolāpurāgnijihvā caṇḍebhyaḥ baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādi stutyantaṃ || namostu jamarājāya dakṣiṇādhipateśvarāya jñānāṃ vighnanāsāya rakṣārthaṃ sannidhirbhava || atra gaṃdhādi || iti dakṣiṇadvārapūjanavidhi ||
tato nai(-)ṛtya || oṃ hrāṁ kirttitoraṇāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ kīrtidvārāya namaḥ || devadāruvṛkṣāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ nai(-)ṛtyāya śavāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || śavapṛṣṭhasamārūḍhaṃ khaḍgahasta mahāvaraṃ | dhūmravarṇa mahātejaṃ mayā hṛdrākṣaseśvaraṃ ||
oṃ hrāṁ kṣuṁ nai(-)ṛtyāya namaḥ || dhvajā || oṃ hrāṁ śūṁ khaḍgāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā oṃ hrāṁ vāmanāya namaḥ || bali || oṃ hrāṁ aṭṭahāsāgnijihvā krodhebhyaḥ bali gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādi stutyantaṃ || namostute niśeśāya nai(-)ṛtyaṃ ca diśāpate || yajñānāṃ pālanārthāya rakṣārthaṃ saṃnidhirbhava || atra gandhādi || iti nai(-)ṛtyadvārapūjāvidhi ||
tato paścimadvārapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ valatolanāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sāmavedāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ dvāparayugāya namaḥ || śūle || oṃ hrāṁ arghamne(?) namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ mitrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ tvaṣṭe namaḥ || śākhā || oṃ hrāṁ bhūsaṃjīvanāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ amṛtāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ janalokāye namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ tapalokāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śukrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śaniścarāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ tavargge vārāhī namaḥ ||
oṃ hrāṁ pavargge indrāṇī namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ dhātre namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vidhātre namaḥ ||
dvāra || oṃ hrāṁ nivṛttikalādvārāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ viṣṇave adhidevatāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ gaṇapataye namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sarasvatyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ || tataḥ śākhāyā || oṃ hrāṁ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ skaṃdāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sindhave namaḥ || oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ ||
dhvajā || prūṁ pāśāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ śaṅkukarṇāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ varuṇāya makarāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || makalāsanamārūḍhaṃ pāśahastadhṛtāya ca || gokṣīra kanake śubhraṃ varuṇaṃ dhyāyate sadā || vūṁ varuṇāya namaḥ ||
bali || oṃ hrāṁ jayanti kālotmarttabhyaḥ baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādi stutyantaṃ || namo'stute jalādhīśa duritaṃ yajñarakṣakaḥ || varuṇaṃ ca mahādevaṃ rakṣārthaṃ saṃnidhirbhava || atragaṃdhādi ||
tato vāyuvya || oṃ hrāṁ puṣṭitoranāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ puṣṭidvārāya namaḥ || cūtavṛkṣāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vāyave mṛgāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || mṛgāsana sthitaṃ devaṃ dhvajahasta mahābalaṃ || haritañca sutejāṅga vāyavyaṃ pavanādhipaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ yūṁ vāyave namaḥ ||
dhvajā || dhūṁ dhvajāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvāya namaḥ || bali || oṃ hrāṁ caritrakarāla kapālīśebhyaḥ baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādistutyantaṃ ||
namo'stute ca vāyuvya prāṇānāṃ pavanādhipa | yajñavighni vināśāya rakṣārthaṃ sannidhirbhava || atra gandhādi || iti vāyuvyapūjā ||
tato uttaradvārapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ ārogyatoraṇāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ atharvvavedāya namaḥ || śūle || oṃ hrāṁ viṣṇave namaḥ ||
oṃ hrāṁ savite namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ aṃśumate namaḥ || śākhayo || oṃ hrāṁ dhanadāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śrīpadāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ satyalokāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ dhruvalokāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ rāhave namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ketave namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ yavargge cāmuṇḍāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śavargge mahālakṣmī namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ āvahāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vivahāya namaḥ || dvāre || oṃ hrāṁ pratiṣṭhākalādvārāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ brahmaṇe'dhidevatāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ gaṇapati namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sarasvatyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ || śākhayo || oṃ hrāṁ devyai namaḥ || oṃ caṇḍāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ gaṇḍakyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ kauśikyai namaḥ ||
dhvajā || grūṁ gadāyai phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ netrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ kuverāya meṣāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || yakṣasameṣamārūḍhaṃ gadāhastaṃ dhanādhipaṃ |
pītavarṇa mahākāya dhyāyedvitteśvara prabhuṃ || oṃ hrāṁ suṁ kuberāya namaḥ ||
bali || oṃ hrāṁ ekāmrekapāda bhīṣaṇebhya baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādistutyantaṃ || namo'stute dhanādhyakṣa kuberāya pratiprabhuḥ | pālitāmiha yajñānāṃ vaiśravaṇāyate namaḥ || atra gaṃdhādi ||
tato īśāna || oṃ hrāṁ siddhitoranāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ siddhidvārāya namaḥ || nāgavṛkṣāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ īśānāya vṛṣāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || vṛṣāsanasthitaṃ śāntaṃ śubhrāṅga sphaṭikopamaṃ | triśūlākṣa dharaṃ devaṃ dhyāyate ca sadāśivaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ huṁ īśānāya namaḥ ||
dhvajā || oṃ hrāṁ hrauṁ śūlāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ sumukhāya namaḥ || bali || oṃ hrāṁ devīkoṭa bhīmarūpasaṃhārebhyaḥ baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā ||
dhūpādistutyantaṃ || namaste bhūtanāthāya aiṁśānyāṃ ca patiprabhuḥ || yajñasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya rakṣārthaṃ sannidhirbhava || atra gaṃdhādi ||
tato adha pūjanaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ adhadvārāya namaḥ || aśokavṛkṣāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ viṣṇave kūrmmāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || kūrmmapṛṣṭhasamārūḍhaṃ cakrāhasta suśobhanaṃ || śyāmavarṇa mahātejaṃ janārddana namostute || klīṁ viṣṇave namaḥ ||
dhvajā || klīṁ cakrāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ harṣāya namaḥ || bali || oṃ hrāṁ hāṭakabhairavāya baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādistutyantaṃ || namo'stute dhaśchandāya viṣṇu pātālamādhipa || yajñānāṃ pālanārthāya rakṣārthaṃ sannidhirbhava || atra gandhādi ||
tato urddha || oṃ hrāṁ ūrddhatoraṇāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ūrddhadvārāya namaḥ || campakavṛkṣāya namaḥ ||
oṃ hrāṁ brahmaṇe haṃsāsanāya nama ||
dhyāna || haṃsāsanasthitaṃ devaṃ padmahastaṃ suśobhanaṃ || śvetāruṇapratīkāśa mūrddhasthaṃ paramaṃ śivaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ brahmaṇe namaḥ ||
dhvajā || oṃ hrāṁ padmāya phaṇnamaḥ || patākā || oṃ hrāṁ gaṇāya namaḥ || bali || oṃ hrāṁ acalabhairavāya baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || dhūpādistutyantaṃ ||
namaste ūrddhamīśānaṃ svarggādhipatayaśvaraṃ | yajñarakṣakaraṃ sarvvaṃ rakṣārthaṃ sannidhirbhava || atra gandhādi ||
tato madhyapūjanaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ ślīṁ paśūṃ hūṁ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sarvvādhyātmane maṇḍapāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ paṃcatatvātmane maṇḍapāya namaḥ ||
tato śivaśakti utthānaṃ || maṇḍapa bhramaṇā || tripradakṣiṇaṃ || oṃ bho bho lokapālāḥ svāyudhā sannidhā bhavasva || oṃ yajñasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya vighnānāṃ dhvaṃsanāya ca | yūyaṃ savāhanāstrañca sanniviṣṭa śivājñayā ||
svastivācanaṃ || jalapūraṇa || sarvvasamudrātyādi || pūjanaṃ || nyāsa || arghapātrapūjā || ādhāraśaktayetyādi || vṛṣāsanāya namaḥ || siṃhāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || oṃ hrāṁ karṇikoparidīpyante prajvalantaṃ mahojasaṃ | pañcavaktra trinetrañca caturddaśabhujādhṛtaṃ || śyāmāṅgaharitā kiñcit vanamālāvidhāraṇaṃ || kirīṭamukuṭorddhe tu phaṇāsapta vibhūṣitaṃ || jaṭālaṃvitasorddhe tu dhyāyadevaṃ śikhāśivaṃ | śaṃkha cakra gadā padmaṃ kapāla khaṭvāṃgameva ca || parśu triśūlahastañca ḍamaru akṣamālikā | bījapūlakavaradaṃ āyudhāni vicintayet || anya bāhu dvayabhyāñcakacarmmāvṛtavigrahaṃ || garjjantañca māhāghoraṃ dvātriṃśaśaktisaṃyutaṃ || devasyeva yathārūpaṃ caturvaktra bhujāṣṭakaṃ | kapāla khaṭvāṅgaparśuṃ śūlaṃ ḍamaru mālikā ||
bījapūrotparadharā āyudhā parameśvarī | śivaśaktivaro dhyānaṃ bhagaliṃgāṅkamudrayā || evaṃ dhyātvā yajeddevaṃ yajñakarmma śubhāvahaṃ || iti dhyānaṃ ||
varddhani pāśupatāstreṇa pūjā || mūlamantreṇa triyāñjali || śaktyā saha || hṛdayādisaṃpūjya || vaktrapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ brahmaṇe nama || oṃ hrāṁ viṣṇave nama || oṃ hrāṁ sadāśivāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ amṛtīśāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ mṛtyuṃjayāya nama || oṃ hrāṁ ādityādinavagrahebhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ kṛttikādinakṣatrebhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ viskambhādi yogebhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ pratipadādi tithibhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ meṣādi dvādaśarāśibhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ gaṃgāyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ jamunāyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sarasvatyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ godāvaryyai namaḥ ||
oṃ hrāṁ narmmadāyai nama || oṃ hrāṁ tuṃgabhadrāyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ kāveryai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ aśvasthāmādyaṣṭaciraṃjivībhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vaśiṣṭādi sapta ṛṣibhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ anantādyaṣṭanāgebhyo namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śāntyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vidyāyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ nivṛtyai namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ pratiṣṭhāyai namaḥ || mūlena triyāñjali || śaktyā saha || ṣaḍaṅgapūjā || āvāhanādi | liṅgayonimudrā || dhūpa dīpa || kuśena paristaraṇaṃ || astramantraṇa || pratiṣṭhā || pratisthitosi || pratisthitosi ||
stuti || śuddhaḥ śānta saśubhraṃ sphaṭikamaṇimayaṃ pallavaṃ chatrayuktaṃ cāṣṭaṃ tīrthaṃ prayuktaṃ sakalajalanidhi pañcaratnoṣadhīnāṃ | yajña yājñe prayuktaṃ munijanasakalaṃ sevitaṃ sarvvabhāvaṃ tvāṃ vande naumi bhaktyā śivaśagatijutaṃ kumbhamūrtti namostute ||
atra gaṃdhādi || iti śivaśakti kalaśārccanaṃ || jñānakhaḍga samarpaṇaṃ || adya vārohākatthe || vākya ||
umāyai bhagarūpiṇyai liṅgarūpadharāya ca || śaṃkarāya namastubhyaṃ bhaktyānugrahakāraṇaṃ || iti bhagaliṃgikaraṇaṃ || yajñasyāsyapatitvaṃ hi mūrttireṣo tano valā | eṣa te jñānanistriṃśastagṛhānasvamāyudhaṃ || iti samarppaṇaṃ ||
prārthayet || yadidaṃ kriyate yatnā bhagavan makhamandinaṃ || rakṣaṇīyaṃ jagannātha sarvvādhareraratvayā || oṃ hsauṁ śivaśaktibhyāṃ namaḥ || iti śivaśaktikaraśārccanaṃ ||
tato indrādikalaśārcanaṃ || oṃ lūṁ indrāya namaḥ || oṃ rau hetukabhairavāya namaḥ || oṃ rau tripurāntakabhairavāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ vāyutatvāya namaḥ || oṃ hai tatpuruṣāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ avarggāya namaḥ ||
oṃ hrāṁ kavargāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ kṣārārṇavāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ aśitāṅgāya namaḥ || kuśena paristaraṇaṃ || pratiṣṭhā pratisthitosi ||
atha agni || oṃ hrāṁ ruṁ agnaya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ivarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ cavarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ kṣrīrodāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ rurave namaḥ ||
dakṣiṇa || oṃ hrāṁ muṁ yamāya namaḥ || oṃ rau pāvakabhairavāya namaḥ || oṃ rauṁ jamajihvā bhairavāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ agnitatvāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ aghorāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ uvarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ṭavarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ dadhisamudrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ caṇḍāya namaḥ ||
nai(-)ṛtya || oṃ kṣuṁ nai(-)ṛtyāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ṛvarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ tavarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sarppisamudrāya namaḥ oṃ hrāṁ krodhāya namaḥ ||
paścime || oṃ hrāṁ vūṁ varuṇāya namaḥ ||
oṃ hrāṁ pṛthvītatvāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ sadyojātāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ḷvarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ pavarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ikṣū dadhaye namaḥ || oṃ unmattāya namaḥ ||
vāyuvya || oṃ hrāṁ yuṁ vāyuvye namaḥ || oṃ evarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ yavarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ surādhvaṃya namaḥ || uttare || oṃ hrāṁ sūṃ kuberāya namaḥ || oṃ rauṁ ekapādabhairavāya namaḥ || oṃ rau bhīmarūpabhairavāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ āptatvāya nama || oṃ phiṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ ovarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śavarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ rasasamudrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ bhīṣaṇāya namaḥ || īśāna || oṃ hūṁ īśānāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ avarggāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ akṣavarggābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ śivasamudrāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ saṃhārabhairavāya namaḥ || kuśena paristaraṇaṃ ||
pratiṣṭhā || pratisthitosi || gaṇakalasapūjā || oṃ gajāsanāya nama ||
dhyāna || oṃ ekadraṃṣṭraṃ mahākāyaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ mahādyutiṃ || gajavaktro mahāvīro dyāyeddevaṃ gaṇādhipaṃ || oṃ gaṁ gaṇapataye namaḥ || dhūpādi stuti || gajavaktro mahāvīryyo mūlamodaka pāṇi dhṛk || nirvvighnaṃ sarvvakāryyeṣu gaṃgāputra namostute || atra gaṃdhādi || iti gaṇakalasa || gurukalaśapūjā || oṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || kuṅkumāvarṇasaṃbhūtamakṣamālāṃ ca pustakaṃ || iśānadiśisaṃsthānaṃ gurumūrtti vibhāvayet || oṃ hrāṁ guruve namaḥ ||
dhūpādi stuti || devatānāñca sarveṣāmṛṣīṇāñca narādayaḥ || gurumūrtti namastestu sarvvaśāstraviśārada || atra gandhādi || iti gurukaraśapūjā ||
kṣetrakalaśapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ narāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || varvvarā piṅgakeśaśca piṅgabhrū piṅgarocanaḥ | daṇḍaṃ ḍamaru khaṭvāṃgaṃ triśūlaṃ ca kapālinaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ kṣāṁ kṣatrāya namaḥ || dhūpādi stuti ||
narāsanasamāsthāya vāyuvya dakṣiṇe sthite | sarvvagrahasamāsthāya kṣetrapāla namostute || atra gamdhādi || iti kṣetrakalaśapūjā ||
yoginīkalaśapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ vahnyāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || śvetavarṇa mahādīptā sarvvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā | nair(-)ṛtya pūrvvataḥ sthāne yoginī dhyāyate sadā || oṃ hrāṁ yāṁ yoginī namaḥ || dhūpādi stuti ||
trailokya vyāpiṇī devī karttikāpāla dhāriṇī | vighnamarddakarīdevī yoginī ca namostute || atra gandhādi || iti yoginīkalaśa ||
śrīkalaśapūjā || makarāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || padmoparisthitā devī nīlotpaladalaprabhā |
siṃdūrapadmahastāṃ ca kāntiyauvanasaṃsthitā || oṃ hrāṁ śrīṁ mūrttaye namaḥ || dhūpādi stuti ||
makalāṅga sthitā devī lokatraya pūjitā | siṃdūrotpala pāṇibhyāṃ śrīdevīṃ praṇamāmyahaṃ || atra gaṃdhādi || iti śrīkalaśapūjā ||
lakṣmīkalaśapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ kūrmmāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || padmasiṃhāsanārūḍhāṃ himagokṣīrasaṃnibhāṃ | trinetrā divyarūpāṃgī hemā bharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || khaḍgapheṭakahastāṃ ca padmoparaśudhāriṇī | evaṃ dhyātvā mahādevī mahālakṣmī namāmyahaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ lakṣmīmūrttaya namaḥ || dhūpādi stuti ||
kūrmmapīṭhāsanāsīnāṃ tu pārakumudojvalāṃ | padmadarppaṇasaṃyuktāṃ lakṣmīdevī namāmyahaṃ || atra gaṃdhādi || iti lakṣmīkalaśa ||
astra vāstu śāntika pustika ||
ādityakalaśapūjā || padmāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || raktapadmāsanāsīnaṃ saptāśca rathasaṃyutaṃ | raktavarṇa mahātejaṃ dādimī kusumaprabhaṃ || evaṃ cintayate bhānuṃ sarvvapāpanāsanaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ adityāya iśvarādhidevatāya agnipratyadhidevatāya namaḥ || dhūpādi stuti ||
sahasrāṃśu mahātejaṃ maṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitaṃ | kuḥpāhri samīpāṇiṃ kavaraṃ ratnavigrahaṃ || atra gaṃdhādi || iti ādityakalaśapūjā ||
nāgakumbha || oṃ blūṁ varuṇāya namaḥ || varuṇāya namastubhyaṃ || mṛtyuṃjayakalasapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ vṛṣāsanāya namaḥ ||
dhyāna || vṛṣasiṃhasthitaṃ devaṃ kṣīrakundendu sannibhaṃ | ekavaktraṃ trinetrañca caturbhuja maheśvaraṃ || triśūlākṣadharaṃ deva varākaśastadhāraṇaṃ | vāmorustha gatā devī dvibhujā kalaśāvaro ||
hemā bharaṇabhūṣāṅgī śvetāmbaravibhūṣaṇa | eṣāmṛtīśvaraṃ dhyāyet sarvvapāpapranāśanaṃ || oṃ juṃ saḥ mṛtyuṃjayāya amṛtīśāya namaḥ || aśvatthāmādi aṣṭaciraṃjīvibhyo nama || dhūpādi stuti ||
amṛteśī maheśāya viśvārtti dhvaṃsanāya ca | parāpara svarūpā ca namaste trayalocane || atra gaṃdhādi || iti mṛtyuṃjayakalaśapūjā ||
uttare yakṣayakṣaṇīpūjā ||
dhyāna || aśvārūḍhaṃ gajāhastaṃ yakṣiṇyāliṃgataṃ karaṃ || vāstusthañca sadā dhyāyet kuberaṃ sarvvaśāntidaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ mlūṁ yakṣāya namaḥ || oṃ hrāṁ mlūṁ yakṣinyai namaḥ ||
dhūpādi stuti || yakṣaśvaraṃ jakṣanāthaṃ vighnānāṃ dhvasanāya ca || yūyaṃ savāhanāste ca saṃnidhīṃ tu śivājñayā || atra gaṃdhādi || iti yakṣayakṣanīpūjā ||
tato yathānukrameṇa sthaṃḍilapūjā || nyāsādi || ātmapūjā || vidhivat hṅathukuhnuyokoṇaṃ sāṅgopāṅgakramārccanaṃ kārayet || sthaṇḍilī sadakvapūjanaṃ dhūpādi stuti || oṃ hrāṁ śriyai namaḥ || oṃ hrīṁ lakṣmī namaḥ ||
upādikalaśapūjā || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ sarvvakaraśāya namaḥ || nidrākalaśa || oṃ hrāṁ devagarbhāyai nidrāyai namaḥ || śaryyākalaśa || oṃ hrāṁ śaryyāyai namaḥ || pakṣāya nama || mārggādi māsebhyo nama || ṛtave namaḥ || saṃmvatsarāya namaḥ || nandādi tithibhyo namaḥ || aśvanyādi nakṣatrebhyo namaḥ || viskaṃbhādi yogebhyo namaḥ || mūhūrttebhyo namaḥ ||
atha sagonapūjā || mūlana vīkṣarīna triyāñjlicchāya || sthānabalipūjā ||
kvācche mūlapātrasapūjā || tritatvananosiya || gurunamaskāra || vatīśi nyāsa || jala arghapātrapūjā || bhūtaśuddhi || ātmapūjā || śrīśamvarttāna āvāhanādi || trideva yoginī || svasvamudrā || brahmānyādi || (8) || aghora || vajra || vatīśi || mūlana triyāñjali (3) || āvāhanādi || dukhā pikhā || savyabhyo bhūtebhyo baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || savyabhyo piśācibhyo baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || cāśvara || trideva || aiṁ (5) caṁ chaṁ jaṁ jhaṁ ñaṁ kmlvryūṁ śrīkomārī vicce pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || hṛdayādi || mūlamantra || hakāra sakāra || tvākamahābali || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā || nāśvara || trideva || oṃ hūṁ hskṣmlvryūṁ nṛtyaśvaramahābhairavāya bhairavāya
śkṣmlvryīṁ nṛtyalakṣmī saktisahitāya pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || hṛdayādi || tvākamahābali || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā || uparaju || trideva || aiṁ (5) śrī(-)anādimahāpiṭhi merumahākṣetre kaurigṛhe hskhphruṁ kubjike hskṣmlvryūṁ śrīkulackreśvaranātha ambā pādukāṃ || bali || aiṁ (5) śrī(-)anādimahāpīṭhi merumahākṣetre kaurigṛhe śkhphrīṁ kubjike śkṣmlvryīṁ śrīkulacakreśvarī ambā pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || hṛdayādi || tvākamahābali || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā || thānalaṃkhu trideva || aiṁ (5) thrauṁ prastaradvīpa daṃbhakīdevi mahādhvāṃkṣetrapālāya pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || hṛdayādi || tvākamahābali || āvāhanādi || tarjjanimudrā || rājakarāka || tri deva ||
aiṁ (5) hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ karaṃkeśvara karaṃkabhairavīśvarī namaḥ || (3) || bali || hṛdayādi || tvākamahābali || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā ||
vaccharādevī || trideva || paśchimayā mūrana || (3) || navākṣarīna || (3) || baliḥ || hṛdayādi || tvākamahābali || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā ||
togaṇa || trideva || kmlvryūṁ śrīkaumārī vicce pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā || phelaju || tirdeva || hsphrāṁ hsphrīṁ hsphrūṁ śrīśikhāsvacchandabhairavāya pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā || udara paścimadari khāṅāvayāya || galāla || dumāju || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā || dhūpa dīpa || naivedya || japa || trideva vmlvryūṁ svāhā || kmlvryūṁ svāhā || ha (9) sa (9) svāhā || hskhphrūṁ
śkhphrīṁ svāhā || throṁ svāhā || hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ svāhā || hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ navākṣarī || kmlvryūṁ svāhā || hsphrāṁ svāhā || galala || dumāju || stotra || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃtyādi || śrīsaṃvattā || vaiṣṇavī viṣṇumāyāñca || pūrvvaṃ dakṣīna || vārabhāve || brahmātāradhare || pīṭhe madhyani ||| vaṃde sadā || dhūmābhaṃ dīpanetraṃ || syāmāraktā || utphūlāṃ || āṁ kroṁ kliṁ komārī || kvākāsa || raktāyā || piṅgākṣī || yathā vānatyādi || tarppaṇa || gorajā sagaṇapūjā || mūsāsanāya nama || triyāñjali || gāṁ gīṁ gūṁ ga kulagaṇeśvarāya namaḥ || bali || dhūpa || dīpa || japa || glauṁ svāhā || (10) || stotra || siṃdūra sāndramadatyādi || atra gaṃdhādi ||
atha gogrāsapūjā || oṃ nandāya namaḥ || oṃ subhadrāya namaḥ || surabhī namaḥ ||
suśīrāya namaḥ || sumanoharāya namaḥ || thava (2) baliḥ || dhūpa dīpa || thava (2) mantrana jāpa ||
stotra || nandā subhadrā surabhi suśīlā sumanoharā || pavitraṃ pāpanāśāya paṃcagomātraya namaḥ || atra gandhādi ||
atha komāri pūjā || mayūrāsanāya namaḥ || tiryāñjali || caṁ chaṁ jaṁ jhaṁ ñaṁ kmlvryūṁ caṁ komārī caṇḍabhairavāya pādukāṃ || (3) || ṣaḍaṅga || bali || dhūpa || dīpa || jāpa || kmlvryūṁ svāhā || (10) || stotra || vārabhāvetyādi || atra gandhādi ||
atha sughaṃnāgapūjā || atra kulanāgerājyebhyo namaḥ || anantapuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ phanādaśadasairjjutaṃ | vidyudvāma pratīkāśaṃ kurmārudhaṃ vicintayat || atra gandhādi ||
kevopūjā || śrīśrīsūryyāya nama || śrīpaśupatibhaṭṭārikāya namaḥ || śrīgaruḍanārāyanāya nama ||
śrīmāneśvarī iṣṭadevatāya nama || sveṣṭadevatāyai namaḥ || (4) || śrīvaruṇanāgarājyebhyo nama || hnasakanasidha muṅapūjā || śriyai namaḥ || śakta namaḥ || dhūpa dīpa || naivedya tāmburādi || pratiṣṭhā || jāpa stotra || iṣṭadeva namastubhyetyādi || atra gaṃdhādi ||
kramamaṇḍalapūjanaṃ || tato yajamānena kṣetrimāvāhanaṃ || dvārāge nirmmacchana || dīpa loharakṣā || candanādi || khaḍga sāhityena || avicchinnajaladhārayā kuṇḍapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā || nair(-)ṛtya uttarābhimukhaṃ sthāpya || idamāsanādi pādārgha || hastārgha || candana yajñopavitādi sarvvamupahāramupaḍhaukitaṃ || atra gaṃdhādi || hotā paṭhati ||
oṃ ehi toraṇayajñasya grahavighnivāraṇaḥ || samastayajñe pūjāyā malaṃkṛtyaṣpṛhānataḥ ||
naranāja nityaṃ rakṣa bhava vighninivāraṇaṃ || kṣatriyāṇāṃ evamastu || iti kṣatri āvāhanaṃ ||
tato hotākuṇḍasamīpaṃ sthitvā || paṭhet || oṃ bhagavan || agnikāyyaṃ kakaromīśa sagaṇaṃ yajñasaṃyutaṃ | haratvaṃ sarvvavighnāni varamājñāñca dehi me ||
siṃhāsane catuḥsaṃskāra || mūlena nirīkṣanaṃ || astreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ || kavacena avaguṇṭhanaṃ || astrena tāḍanaṃ || siṃhāsanopari upaviśya || paṭhet || trailokyayāni bhūtāti sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | brahmāviṣṇu śive śāṅga rakṣāṃ kurvvaṃtu me sadā || devadānavagandharvvā yakṣarākṣasa pannagā || meṣayo manavo gāvo deva mātara eva ca || sarvvasamādhare rakṣāṃ kurvvantu ca mudānvitā ||
mūlena nyāsa || jalapātra arghapātrapūjā ||

thvate parivāraganayā || gurustotra || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || (1) ||
śrīsaṃvarttāmalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭi nyāye catuṣkaṃ tvakulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ | catvāroḥ pañcakonyāt punarapi caturaḥ ṣoḍaśājñābhiṣekaṃ divyāṣṭau mūrttimadhye hasakhapharaka lābindupuṣpākhamudrā || (2) ||
bālaṃ kaumāra vṛddhaṃ paramaśivakalā vakradevīkramāṇāṃ śrīnāthaṃ candrapūryyāṃ navanavakalitaṃ yugmabhedastu sāraṃ | trīṇi siddhāvatāraṃ prathamakaliyuge koṅkaṇe cādhikāraṃ teṣāṃ vai putra śiṣyā navapuruṣamate teṣu madhyā dviraṣṭau || (3) ||
saṃntānaṃ gotrapiṇḍaṃ kramapadasakalaṃ ṣoḍaśārccaṃ krāmāntaṃ śeṣā vai maṇḍalāni patibhrama vimalaṃ pujyasajñāvavṛndaṃ | ādāvaṣṭādaśāntaṃ kulakramasakalaṃ maṇḍalotthana pūrvvaṃ saṃskāraṃ trikrameṇa paśumalakṣayakṛtpiṇḍaśuddhiḥ śivāgnau || (4) ||
madhye viśrāma bhūmiṃ prasaramanubhavaṃ pratyayaṃ svādhikāraṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || (5) ||
aiṁ yā sā śaktirbhagākhyā tripathagatiyutā tryakṣarā triprakārā aiṁ tasyāḥ śrī oḍiyāne varakala sahitaṃ madhyasaṃsthaṃ sudīptaṃ |
hrīṁ tacchrī jālandharākhye prakaṭita nilaye dakṣiṇe caiva koṇe śrīvāme śrīpūrṇapīṭhe paśujanabhayakṛtpūritaṃ yena viśvaṃ || (6) ||
hsphreṁ tasyāgre kāmarūpaṃ madanakaliyutaṃ sarvvasiddhālayañca hsoḥ trikoṇānte samastaṃ paramaśive kalālaṃ kṛtaṃ yogavṛndaṃ || kṣmāṁ tanmadhye divyaliṃgaṃ paramasukhakaraṃ bindurūpaṃ kharūpaṃ klīṁ nityānandasvarūpaṃ taduparimathanaṃ ṣaṭprakārairvvibhinnaṃ || (7) ||
glūṁ vidyābhogāya gamye anubhava vimalaṃ trisrapīṭhe lalāṭe aiṁ evaṃ vyāptaṃ samastaṃ sthitilayajananī rudraśaktistribhedā | aiṁ tatrasthā devadevī tvakulakulamayānandadhātrī svatantrā oṃ gurvājñābindubhūtā paśubhayaharaṇī siddhadivyaugharūpā || (8) ||
hsauṁ nityakliṃnā suraktā bhagavati tapadānandadhātrī prasiddhā kṣmāṁ kurvvantī yatra kāmākṣubhitavaratanuṃ śrīkubjikākhyāṃ namāmi || (9) ||
saṃntānaṃ merumārgeṇa anvayaṃ tatra devatā | nirggamaḥ pīṭha oṃkāre siddhā tvaye prakīrttitāḥ || 10 || tūṣṇībhūtā guhāvāsī vṛkṣaścaiva kadambakaḥ | saṃketa sevitaṃ proktamambā ca guhavāsinī || 11 || gṛhaṃ cāndrapuraṃ proktaṃ bhedo manthānabhairavaḥ | gotra amarikādevī vāmamārgge prakalpayet || 12 || anvayaṃ pratyayaścāramadhikārantu koṅkaṇe | janma brahmaśilā sthāne sthitiḥ śrīkāmarūpake || 13 || kīrttiściṃcini vṛkṣe tu siddhiścaiva tu sārake | tuṣṭohaṃ tasya deveśi yojānātilakramaṃ || 14 || ṣoḍaśādhāra bhedena nyāsaṃ kūṭaṃ kramantathā | pūjitaṃ siddhidaṃ bhadre suśiṣyāya nivedayat || 15 ||
thvate trīsutra || mahāmayā || oṃ namo'stute māhāmāye sūkṣmadehe parāpare | ekākini viśuddhātmā nādākhye vindu mālinī || 16 || adehā ca samutpanne acale viśvadhāriṇī | mahākuṇḍalinī nitye haṃsamadhye vyavasthitā || 17 || somasūryyāgnimadhyasthe vyomavyāpī parāpare | oṃkāravigrahāvasthe hakārārddhadhāriṇī || 18 || bālāgra śatadhā sūkṣma anante cākṣaye vyaye | hakārārddha kalādhāre padmakiñjalka māśrite || 19 || sakalākhye mahāmaye varade lokapūjite | ekaikanātrimadhyasthe marmmamekaika bhedini || 20 || aṣṭātriṃśatkalādevi bhedinī brahmaraprage | vidyullatānibhādevī bhūjaṅgakuṭilākṛtiḥ || 21 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivāḥ |
ete pañcamahāpretāḥ pādamūle vyavasthitāḥ || 22 || trailokyajananīdevī namaste śaktirūpiṇī | idā piṅgalamadhyasthe mṛṇālatanturūpiṇī || 23 || bindumadhyagatādevī kuṭile cārddhacandrike | tuṣārakanikābhāse dvādaśāntāvalambinī || 24 || umāṅge hṛṅgatā gaurī dvādaśādityavarccase | sthūle śūkṣmāntarāvasthā haṃsākhye prāṇadhāriṇī || 25 || lambākhye paramādevī dakṣiṇottaragāminī | nāsāgre tu samuttīrṇṇe madhye sutrapravāhinī || 26 || hṛllekhe paramānande tālamurddhnivyavasthite | nādaghaṇṭike saṃghṛṣṭe guṇāṣṭaka samanvite || 27 || sthūlasūkṣme susaṃkṣuddhe dharmmādharmmapuṭadvaye | kāryyakāraṇakartṛtve triśūnye nādavigrahe || 28 || parāparapare śuddhe caitanye śāsvate dhruve |
sarvvavarṇadharīdevī guhyasthāne vyavasthitā || 29 || jagatastāriṇī devī saṃvṛtyāpathagāminī | aśarīre mahābhāge saṃsārārṇavatāriṇi || 30 || jayā ca vijayā caiva ajitā cāparājitā | tumburu bījamadhyasthe namaste pāpamocani || 31 || bandhamokṣakarīdevī ṣoḍaśānte vyavasthitā | bhrāmaṇī śaktiśūlena mahāvyuhasamanvite || 32 || bhramaṇī bhrāmaṇī gaurī māyā yantra pravāhinī | svacchandabhairavīdevī saṃkrodhonmattabhairavī || 33 || pañcāśadvarṇarūpasthā tvayā rudrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ | amṛtākhye ruruścaṇḍe namaḥ kāpālinī śive || 34 || ruruṃkṣaṇī mahāmāye namaste jñānabhairavī | daṃṣṭrotkaṭe vidyurjjihve tārakākṣī bhayānane || 35 ||
namāmi devadeveśi aghore ghorarūpiṇi | jvālāmukhī vegavarī umādevī namostute || 36 || yoginī ca śriyādevī gaurī lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | haṃsavāgīśvarīdevī gomukhī śaktimālinī || 37 || koṣṭhāṅgī subhagādevī durggā kātyāyanī tathā | nityaklinnā samākhyātā raktā caikākṣarāparā || 38 || brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā | vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍā tvaṃ bhayānanā || 39 || yogeśī tvaṃ hi deveśi kurāṣṭakasamanvitā | aindrī caiva tathāgneyī yāmyā nair(-)ṛtya vāruṇī || 40 || vāyavyā caiva kauverī aiṃśānī samudāhṛtā | prayāgā varuṇākolo aṭṭahāsā jayantikā || 41 || caritraikāmrakā caiva devīkoṭe ca cāṣṭadhā | tathā kālī hyumādevī devadūtī namostute || 42 || bhadrakālī mahādevī cāmuṇḍā tvaṃ bhayāvahā |
mahocchūkṣme mahāśānte namaste śaktirūpiṇī || 43 || bhūrbbuvaḥ sveti svāhānte dayā devi kuruṣva me | jñānārthine mahāmāye etadicchāmi vedituṃ || 44 || yastvidaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃñcaiva mānavāḥ | prāpnoti cintitātkāmānstriṇāñca vallabho bhavet || 45 ||
iti śivaśaktisamarasatve mahāmāyā stotraṃ samāptaḥ || (8) ||
kṣetrayā || piṅgākṣaṃ raktakeśaṃ kiṇi kiṇi rarave kiṅkiṇī mālajālaṃ draṃṣṭrāsyaṃ krūrabhāvaṃ sakalaviṣaharaṃ pātrahastaṃ ca nādaṃ | suvyaktaṃ siṃhanādaṃ rararararavanavarvvaraṃ vyomatatvaṃ bhūtapretādhināthaṃ sakalabhayaharaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ namāmi || 46 ||
raktāmbaraṃ jvalitapiṅgajatākalāpaṃ jvālāvalijatila daṇḍadhara pracaṇḍaṃ | sūryyodayācca kanakā cala śṛṅgagauraṃ gaurī sutaṃ vaṭukanāthahaṃ namāmi || 47 ||
vaṭukayā || gaṇayā || haṃtāraṃkhedaduḥkhaṃ śamitabhavabhayaṃ sarvvavighnāntakāyaṃ gāṁ gīṁ gūṁ gaiṁ ṣaḍāṅge gaganagatigate siddhisarvvārthadāyaṃ | oṃ glūṁ mūdrā gajākhye gasapavanagate ākhuyānaikadante oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ hāṁ gāṁ gaṇeśe dviramukhagaṇe vighnanāthe namaste || 48 ||
navātmāyā || ūkāro nṛtyapādo hasakṣamalabhūjobodharaścāgniliṅgā vāyuvyāghrājināṅkaḥ śaśiśakalaśirobindunādorddhayuktaḥ | niryyaṅgaṅgāmbudhārā ṛjuparamakalā bhairavo mantramūrttiḥ yā yāddevo navātmā sakalaguruvaro bhairavaḥ śrīkujeśaḥ || 49 ||
brahmānyādi || brahmāṇī kamalendu saumyadanī māheśvarī līlayā kaumārī ripudarppanāśanakarī cakrāyudhā vaiṣṇavī
vārāhī ghaṇaghorarghagharamukhī aindrī ca vajrāyudhā cāmuṇḍa gaṇanāthabhairavagaṇā rakṣantu me mātṛkāḥ || 50 ||
madhya trisrāsanasthā madamuditamukhā vajrapadme sudīptā brahmāṇyādyaṣṭapatre svaradigapraṇave śrīprayāgādikṣatre | yuktāṣṭāviṃśakoṇe casaṣasahasakhe vajraśṛṃge sphuranti sāṣṭāviṃśāstribhedāḥ kramapadasahitāḥ pāntu dvātriṃśavarṇāḥ || 51 ||
krarmmayā || khaḍgaṃbā mantrasiddhiṃ parapuraviśanaṃ khegatiṃ locanaṃ vāśaśtustaṃbhaṃ ripūṇāṃ baliparitajayaṃ stambhanaṃ sarvvavidyāṃ | dīrghāyuṣyaṃ kavitvaṃ nidhirasaguṭikāṃ pādukāmasiddhiṃ sarvvāṃ cintāṃ dadante alipiśitaratābhairavenānuraktāḥ || 21 ||
paścimayā || śyāmāraktā trinetrāstanabharanamitā mattamātaṅgagāmī bimboṣṭhī cārunetrā pṛthutarajaghanā mekhalā ratnaśobhe |
devāṅgairvvastraśobhe varavakusume varvvare keśabhāre sāmeśrī kubjikākhyā vitaratutarasājñānadivyaughamoghaṃ || 53 ||
bandhukadyuti sundarī trinayanīṃ sihāsanī sundarī sarvveṣāmiha sarvvaśatruharanī śuklāvarābhūṣitāṃ | yasyāṣṭādaśapāṇi padmavimalāṃ vāñcā phalārthapradāṃ tām vande mahiṣāsura pramathanīṃ tumbeśvarī naumyahaṃ || 54 || tumbeśvarīyā ||
śikhā || kvākāśaḥ kvasamīraṇaḥ kvadahana kvāpaḥ kvaviśvambharā kvabrahmā kvajanārddanaḥ kvattajagaḥ kvenduḥ kvadevāsurāḥ || kalpāntālabhaṭī naṭapramuditaḥ śrīsiddhiyogeśvaraḥ krīḍānāṭakanāyako vijayate devo mahābhairavaḥ || 55 ||
mahākālayā || mahākālaṃ mahāraudraṃ mahākṛṣṇañjana prabhaṃ | sthūlarūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ kartṛ kāpāladhāriṇaṃ
khaḍgapheṭakadharaṃ devaṃ trinetraṃ jvalala prabhaṃ namastestu mahākāla śatrusaṃhārakārakaṃ || 57 ||
ugracaṇḍāyā || mārkkaṇḍeyo vipadupadahatānugrahāyāvatāre ścakreyasma pracūrṇakaraṇo brahmavidbrahmakalpaḥ | daityocchedapramudita suraso strotra garbhaprabhāvaḥ soyaṃ devyā bhavatu bhavatāṃ śreyase caṇḍikāyāḥ || 58 ||
ugracaṇḍīyā || yā devī madhukaiṭabha pramathanī yā caṇḍamuṇḍārddinī yā mādyā mahiṣāsurakṣayakarī yā raktabījāśrayā | yā sā śuṃbhaniśumbhadaityadalanī yā devadevāśrayā sā devī mama rakṣa dakṣiṇabhujaiścaṇḍī jayo rakṣatu || 59 ||
mūlayā || utphullāmbuja karṇikopari gatā śrīsiddhilakṣmīḥ parā karppūrasphaṭikenduktandadhavalā niḥśeṣa pāśāpahā |
saṃsārārṇavaduḥkhapaṃkadahanī niṣkampanaṃ sarvvadā śrīmatpañcamukhāmbujā daśabhujā pretasthitā pātu naḥ || 60 ||
siddhiṃ parāpara mayī vitanotu devī yāśeṣamantra jananī matulaprabhāvā | tāṃ naumi māṃ taramaramajāṃ parabodha dhāmāṃ vidhyastahārddamirāmiha siddhilakṣmīṃ || 61 ||
āsāpūraṇi pāpahāraṇi jagadduḥkhaughavidrāvaṇi kleśottāriṇi vairimāriṇi sadā saṃsāramohāriṇi | śreyaskāriṇi kāraṇeśvaraparaprānādyasaṃcāriṇi tvāṃ sadyonitarāmabhīṣṭā phaladāṃ śrīsiddhilakṣmīṃ namaḥ || 62 ||
prauḍhapretādhirūḍhāṃ bhujadaśakayutāṃ paṃcavaktrāṃ trinetrāṃ brahmagranthiṃ vibhidyaprakaṭaramatho hṛtsarāje vasantīṃ | piṇḍasthā binduśubhrāmamṛtamayatanuṃ viśvasarggāpavarggā naumi śrīsiddhilakṣmīmabhi mataphaladāṃ sthūlarūpaṃ dadhānāṃ || 63 ||
padmapretādhirūḍhāṃ sphaṭikamaninibhāṃ pañcavaktrāṃ trinetrāṃ trailokyaṃ mohayantīṃ bhujadaśakayutāṃ divyavastrāvṛtāṅgīṃ | vāme kāpālaśūlaṃ ghaṭavarada mahāpāśamuṇḍaṃ vahantīṃ ghaṇṭākhaṭvāṅga khaḍgābhayaśṛṇisahitāṃ siddhilakṣmī namāmiḥ || 64 ||
śrīlakṣmīpratidehayoga paramānandārabindorbhavā rāmāratnaśiromani khaḥlu mahālakṣmīrmmahāmaṅgalā | madhye śaktipayodharā tribhūvanālaṃkārasaṃdvaṃdhanā sendaccandra kalādharā guṇarasā śrīkālikā yoginī || 65 ||
māyāsu bīja vimalendu vibhāta lakṣmīṃ devāsurādi namitā caraṇeṣu bhaktyā | pādārabinda bhavabhakti kṛtārthasārāṃ deviṃ namāmi varadāṃ jaya siddhilakṣmīṃ || 66 ||
nivasati karavīre sarvvadā yā śmaśāne
vinatajanahitāya pretarudrādhirūḍhā | himakara himaśubhrā pañcavaktrā hyamoghā diśatu śabhujāmesāśriyaṃ siddhilakṣmīḥ || 67 ||
aiṁ sā vākyabhavodyatā vijayate saṃpūrṇakāmapradā saṃsārārṇava pātabhāva paramā sarvvārtti hantrī śivā | śrīśarvveṇa dhṛtābjamaṇḍalagatā sānandasiddhipradā seṣaṃ śrīkaruṇapraceta vimalā śrīsiddhilakṣmīḥ parā ||
māyābīja paraṃparātmaka kulāmāyāmayī mālinī mohā mātṛmaheśvarī maṇikule muktāphalādāmabhā | māyāsiddhimanīṣimāna hṛdayayogaprakāṣṭāvidhā mantrārādhana tatparasya kṛpayā sābhīṣṭasiddhipradā || 69 ||
śrīmacchrīśakalendubhāta vimalā śrīkāmaśāntipradā viśvātmābharaitaika viśvajananī jāgrādibodhātmikā | kāruṇyāmṛtavāriṇā parigataṃ lokatrayaṃ siṃcatī
kālānmṛtyudapaṃcatā vijayate śrīsiddhilakṣmīḥ parā || 70 ||
kṣauṁkārādduritaughanāśanakarī cintādhanairvvarddhitaṃ kṛtyaṃ kārita sānumodavividhaṃ jñānanena cājñānajaṃ | pustaṃ śrīkṛpayā pracetanavatī prajñāparātmātmikā śrīsiddhiḥ paramāparā bhagavatī nityā sadā pātu māṃ || 71 ||
kroṃkāraṃ sṛjate karākṣakaraṇaiḥ saṃsārakarttrā parā khaṇḍendūṃ nabhasaṃyutaṃ ca śikhayā nādātmikā nādatāṃ | nityā nirvviṣayā niraṃśavaradābhāvānabhāvāna hī sarvvajñādi guṇeśvarī vijayate mantreśvarī mātṛkā || 72 ||
rudrārūḍha parāparātmajananī śrīsiddhilakṣmī parā candrānekavibhā sudīptikaraṇī siddhipradābodhinī | śobhāśastradharā subhūṣaṇayutā divyāṇi viśvātmikā seyaṃ śrīkaruṇāmayī bhagavatī tvāṃ sevitāhaṃ smare || 73 ||
guhyādā brahmarandhraṃ kulabhavanavibhuḥ sūtramālāḍhya bījairmmālāmantrākṣarīyā prakaṭayati vapuḥ sāyudhaṃ sāṅgabhūtaṃ | sābhūyaḥ sārabhūmau samarasakalayā ṣotraśānte samāste vidyārājñī sadā vaḥ sphuratu parapadaprāptaye siddhilakṣmīḥ || 74 ||
koṭīndūdyūti dīpyamānakiraṇā trailokye vikṣobhaṇīṃ rudrenāpidhṛtaprabhāve mahimaprākrānta viśvālayāṃ | sasārasthiti sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtikarīṃ tīvrapratāpojvalāṃ tvāṃ vande nayanatrayāmalamukhīṃ śrīsiddhilakṣmīmahaṃ || 75 ||
guhyakāliyā || yā sāntakāgnikuharotthita bhāsvarūpā somārkka vahni tripathodaramadhyasaṃsthā | vicceta cittaviṣayākhya vilīnabhāvā sṛṣṭi sthiti pralayakāraṇa tatvarūpā || 76 ||
jñānātmikā sakalabhāvi bhāvabhinnā ānandanandita sadā paramārthalīnā | nāḍīkalā kalitavigrahe mantrarūpā saptādaśākṣara gatā khalucchidravarṇā || 77 ||
vidyāśatākṣaravarā kulakarmma caṇḍā trailokyalaṃpaṭavalā kulasaṃghasidhā | ekā hyanekagati cakravara prapūjyā satsaṃgasiddhavara bhairava pūjitāyā || 78 ||
kāli kalākalitakālakalormmivāhā śrīcakra cakra nilayā navabhedabhinnā | pūrṇā śaśāṃka kalitā kulā bhānurūpā vijñānasiddhivara vahni kulaprasiddhā || 79 ||
ālabdhakhecarapadā pāramapracandrā cakrakrame gadita mantramahārthavedā | satsaṃgasiddhiniratā kulasiddhidātrīṃ svābhāvabhāvitaparāṃ praṇamāmi kālīṃ || 80 ||
yā caṇḍe bhūtabhinnā raviśaśidahane gotracaṇḍe ca rudre
hṛnnābhau kaṇṭhacakre tridahana kuhare dvādaśānte ca saṃsthā | sṛṣṭisthityanta karttrī akulakulayutā sarvvasaṃdoṣadharttrītāṃ kālīṃ naumi nityaṃ paramapadayī saccitānandarūpāṃ || 81 ||
tripurasundarīyā || aiṃndrasyaivaśarāsanasya dadhatīṃ madhye lalāṭe prabhāṃ sauṁ klīṁ kānti manuṣṇa gauri vaśirasyā tatvatāṃ sarvvataḥ || eṣā sau tripurā hṛdidyutiritoṣṇāṃśoḥ sadāhaḥ sthitā chidyānnaḥ sahasā padaistribhiraṃghaṃ jyotirmmayī vāṅmayī || 82 ||
māyākuṇḍalinī kriyāmadhumatī kālī kalā mālinī mātaṅgī vijayā jayā bhagavatī devī śivāśāmbhavī | śaktiḥ śaṃkaravallabhā trinayanī vāgvādinī bhairavī hrīṁ kālī tripurāparāparamayī mātā kumārītyasi || 83 ||
mūlayā pratyaṅgirā ||
namaste devadeveśi siddhilakṣmi mahaujase |
pratyaṅgirā mahādevi rājalakṣmi namostute || 84 || yoginī siddhirūpā ca karuṇāmayarūpiṇī | sānekānekarūpā ca mātṛkāṣṭakamadhyagā || 85 || jagatmāteśvarī devī jagat saṃhavatekṣaṇāt | jagatsthitikarīdevī jagadānandakāriṇī || 86 || trailokyajananīdevī vahni cakrasya madhyagā | ṣaṭkonā cāṣṭapatrā ca caturdvārasamāyutā || 87 || siddhirlakṣmīrmmaheśānī vajrapaṃjararūpiṇī | himakundendu saṃkāśā śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhā || 88 || sarvaśvetā nibhādevī jvalatmānasa tejasā | jatājūṭendu saṃyuktā nīlakuṃcita mūrddhajā || 99 || trinetra pratimā śvetā daśadorddaṇḍadhāriṇī | khaṭvāṅgāsāsaśṛṇo dhṛtvā varaṃ ghaṇṭāñca dakṣiṇe || 90 || kādyaṃ śūlañca pāśaṃ ca abhayā muṇḍavāmake | sarvvālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ hemaratnādilaṃkṛtā || 91 ||
śuklavastraparidhānā madirānanda cetasā | rudraskaṃdhasamārūḍhā rudraḥ sphaṭikasannibhaḥ || 92 || ekāsyaśca trinetraśca khaṇḍendu kṛtaśekharaḥ || caturhasto maheśāni dvayahastakṛtāñjaliḥ || 93 || pretāsanoparisthā tu raktavarṇā mahojvalā | koṭipūrṇendubhādevī jvalatmārttaṇḍatejasā || 94 || nānārūpadharādevī nānāśastrasuśobhitā | bahuvaktrā bahubhujā bahupādā mahābalā || 95 || viśvarūpā maheśānī lakṣmīrūpāvatāriṇī | cintāmaninibhādevī cintitārthaphalapradā || 96 || namaḥ svāhā ca vauṣaṭva hūṁkāra vaṣaḍastrake | ete mantrā mahādevī mantrarūpāvatāriṇī || 97 || ādhāre tu sthitā devī bhujaṃgakuṭilākṛtiḥ | sarppakuṇḍalanī śaktiragamyāgamacāriṇī || 98 || śanaiḥśanaiḥ pracāreṇa brahmāṇḍadvārabhedinī |
aṇimādimahāsiddhiriddhisiddhipradāyinī || 99 || pañcātmā piṇḍasaṃyuktā rājalakṣmī pradāyinī | lakṣmī varddhayate devī dīpakaṃ parameśvarī || 100 || sthūlarūpā maheśāni navatyādi śatadvayaṃ | saptādaśeṣu navame saptapaṃcāśa tryakṣare || 101 || ekākṣare mahādevī sūkṣmarūpāvate namaḥ | ete mantrā mahādevi mantramātarmmaheśvarī || 102 || sarvvapāpavinirmmuktaścāyurārogyavarddhanaḥ | lakṣmīyukto bhavecchrīmānmadonmatta gajendravat || 103 || saptasāgalaparyantaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ sakṛdbhavet | sakṛtsmṛtvā dahet teṣāṃ pāpaughastṛṇarāśivat || 104 || hatvā jagadidaṃ kṛtvā brahmavidbhiḥ prapūjyate | mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva brahmahā bhrūṇahā tathā || 105 || naśyedityādikaṃ pāpaṃ sakṛtsmṛtvā cayorccayet |
trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet stotramekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ || 106 || vandhanānmucyate pāpānigaḍasphoṭanāni ca | novāsaṃkaṭa yantrāṇi stambhayen mocayet sadā || 107 || araṇye viṣamaghore siṃhavyāghrābhisaṃkaṭe | viṣame gahane vāhnau bhūtāpasmārake bhaye || 108 || yantramantrādi cūrṇeṣu yena kṛtvā vināśayat | kulikenāpi daṃṣṭrasya viṣanāśanasaṃbhave || 109 || bhūtāpasmārapakṣyādi pretādīnāñca nāśanaṃ | jvalacāturthakādīni nāśayat smaranādapi || 110 || acintitāni cārthāni sadā tasya bhavanti ca | alakṣmī śamanījñayā duḥkhadāridramarddanī || 111 || lakṣmīśvarīti vikhyātā bahubhogaparāvahā | mahālakṣmīrmmahākrāntā sarvvasaubhāgyadāyinī || 112 ||
madirānandacaitanyā mahāghūrṇīta locanā | ānandasamabhūtātmā viśvarūpāvatāriṇī || 113 || brāhmā raudrī ca kaumārī vaiṣṇavī ghonaghorakā || māhendrī carccikā caiva caṇḍikāṣṭakayoginī || 114 || aṣṭādevī mahāsiddhiḥ siddhiyoginimadhyagā | pūjayedvividhākārārggandhamālādipuṣpakaiḥ || 115 || dhūpayet pūrakarppūra kastūrī samāyutaṃ | ārādhitā jagatsarvvaṃ trailokyamapi pūjitaṃ || 116 || gajāśva mahiṣacchāga gāvaścaiva viddhayet | eṣā pratyaṅgirā rājā jayet sarvvaṃ sadābudhaḥ || 117 || bahunātra kimuktena acintitāni siddhayet | smaraṇā tu sadā devī duḥkhadāridrya nāśinī || 118 || namastestu mahādevi namaste viśvarūpinī | namaste jagatāṃ mātaḥ siddhilakṣmī namostute || 119 ||
iti śrīsiddhilakṣmīpratyaṅgirāstavaḥ samāptaḥ ||
mūlayā || tvamasi paramakālī siddhilakṣmīstvameva tvamasi paramacaṇḍī ugracaṇḍī tvameva | tvamasi paramarājñī rājarājeśvarī tvaṃ sakalanihataśatru sarvvasiddhidadātu || 120 ||
mūlayā || nānyaṃ vadāmi nacinomina cintayāmi nānyaṃ smarāmirabhajāmina cāśrayāmi | tyaktā tvadīya caraṇāmbuja mānya deva mātaḥ svabhūtikṛpayayā mama dehi siddhiṃ || 121 ||
mantrānuvidhistava mūlayā || oṃ namaḥ śrīcaṇḍakāpālinyai || oṃ siddhipadmāyai ||
śrījayadratha uvāca || namāmi śirasādevīṃ sarvvataḥ siddhiyoginīṃ | yat prasādodayācchaktirudeti sahajā parā || (1) || tato namāmi prayatāṃ satataṃ siddhimātaraṃ | samudeti parasphāro yadīya caranārccarāt || (2) ||
bhavānyai bhavasaṃtāpa hāriṇe śaraṇārthināṃ | namo nityoditānaṃdananditāyai namo namaḥ || (3) || sakalakulacakre tvaṃ nāyikā tvena varttase | natvāṃ bhagavatī mantrāṃ caṇḍakāpalininnumaḥ || (4) || etairnavanavollekhaiḥ smṛtvā navabhirakṣaraiḥ | yāṃ devīntāṃ sphuratsphāra dhāriṇīṃ bhagavatīnnuma || (5) || amandānandasaṃdohaṃ yataḥ paramahaṃsinī | nirvvāṇamārgade devi tvatsāraṃ tadidaṃ jagat || (6) || viṣamopaplavabhṛṇapraśamānalamālinī | duritāriṣṭa saṃkleśa dalanīṃ bhagavatiṃ namaḥ || (7) || devi sarvvāpadāmbhodhi taraṇīṃ trijagaṅgatiṃ | tvāmihāmutra sarvvatra śatrupraśamanīnnumaḥ || (8) || āgacchāgaccha varade hasadevi punaḥ punaḥ | valga valga jaganmātaḥ sarvvābhīṣṭapradāyini || (9) || tvameva pūrṇāpiśita rudhirāntravaśāturā |
antarvvahiḥ sarvvaśatrutkāli kṛṣāsiktāpyasau || 10 || tatsa śatrunmamānanda mahāhaṃkāra garvvitān | mardda mardda mahādevi khāhi khāhi maheśvarī || 11 || icchāyāriṃ triśūlena bhindi bhindi punaḥ punaḥ | vimalodbhāsakhaḍgena tāḍaya chedaya dvidhā || 12 || tāvatkuṇḍalinīrūpe vicce matkārabhāsure | yatasvayāvat sādhaya mama sarvvamanorathān || 13 || tvāṃ hi kāruṇika devi mahābhairavarūpini | samastamantratrātāsi sarvvaiḥ suravaraiḥ stutā || 14 || avalokayamāmāsu devi praṇatavatsale | mahākāli namastestu kālanāśinite namaḥ || 15 || uccāṭayāṇḍa me śatrun prasīda parameśvari | madanāturatāṃ yāti yaḥ surāsura kanyakāṃ || 16 || māyamahālakṣmi catuṣkalākhye mohāṃdhakāraṃ tvaritonivāryya |
ciccandrakebhyopi hṛdaṃ parame prakāśayāntaṃ trijagatsvabhāvaṃ || 17 || dhyāne neṣṭaphalapradāṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyātvā yatheṣṭena yastvāṃ bhaktipraṇipātapūtamanasā siddhārccitāmarccayet | sarvvāsaṃpadamāvadentyaharahaḥ saṃpūrṇapūrvo dayāt tattvāṃ naumi sadohitāṃ tribhūvanaprojñāsanī prodyatāṃ || 18 ||
ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ śrījayadrathanirmmitai | sarvvāsalabhate siddhiṃ bhagavatyāḥ prasādataḥ || 19 || tṛṇātparṇācca pāṣāṇāt kaṃdātkudyājjalāt sthalāt | uṅgacchagaccha me trāṇaṃ vibhokvanunate sthitiḥ || 20 ||
iti śrījayadrathanirmmitaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīmantrānuvṛdhistavaḥ samāptaḥ ||
māyāstava mūlayā || oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmyai ||
aiṁ namostute mahāmāye dehātīte niraṃjane | pratyaṃgirā jagaddhātri rājalakṣmi namostute || (1) || varṇadehā mahāgaurī sādhakecchā pravarttikā | padadehā mahāsphāra mahāsiddhisamutthitā || (2) || tatvadehā sthitādevī sādhakānugrahā smṛtā | mahākuṇḍalinī bhitvā sahasradalabhedinī || (3) || iḍāpiṅgalamadhyasthā vāyubhūtā khagāminī | mṛṇālatanturūpiṇyā suṣumnāmadhyacāriṇī || (4) || nādānte nādasaṃsthānā nādātītā nirañjanā | sūkṣme sthūlesi saṃsūkṣme acintyācintyavigrahe || (5) || parāparapareśānte brahmalīne pare śive | aciṃtyarūpacarite acintyārthaphalaprade || (6) || ekākinī viśvamātā kanavīranivāsinī | mahāsphāla pradā nityā mahāmelāpakāriṇī || (7) || bindumadhya sthitā devī kuṭilārddheti candrikā |
dvādaśānta layādevī ṣoḍaśādhāravāsinī || (8) || kāryyakāraṇasaṃbhinnā caitanyā nāḍimadhyagā | śaktimūle mahācakre navadhāsaṃvyavasthitā || (9) || aśarīrā parādevī śarīre prāṇarūpiṇī | sudhādravasamākārā oṃkāra paravigrahā || 10 || vidyullatānibhā gaurī bhāvābhāvavivarjjitā | svāntapadmasthitā nityā pareśī śāntavigrahā || 11 || satvarūpā rajorūpā tamorūpā trayātmikā | tvameva devi sarvveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇadāyinī || 12 || tvameva sṛjyate viśvaṃ līlayā bahudhā sthitā | mālinī paramādevī śmaśānaparabaṃdhinī || 13 || hṛttālubhedinīcakre vicakre cakrasundarī | bindudvāranirodhena divyavyāptā namostute || 14 || sūryyakoṭipratīkāśe candrakoṭyati nirmmale |
kandarppakoṭilāvaṇye koṭi brahmaṇḍavigrahe || 15 || nirākāśe nirābhāśe nirllepe niravigrahe | sakalākhye mahāmāye varade surapūjite || 16 || khakāra phakāra vahnistha ekārāntarasundari | makāntaravarggeṣu pañcapiṇḍātmake śive || 17 || sarppavatkuṭirākāre nādaśakti pare mate | binducakrasthitā nityā jālaṃdhara svarūpiṇī || 18 || turyya vaituryyapīṭhasthe pūrṇapīṭhe vyavasthite | kāmāsthe ca kalātīte kāmākhye ca bhagorbhave || 19 || brahmagranthi kalāṭopa madhyasrotapravāhiṇi | śive sarvvagate sūkṣme nityānandamahotsave || 20 || mantranāyakimantrajñe vidyekonāntavāsini | pañcapīṭhikamadhyasthe merunāyiki śarvvari || 21 || khecarī bhūcarī caiva śaktitrayapravāhini |
kālāntāgnisamudbhute kālakālāntakālinī || 22 || kālikākramasaṃbandhi kāli dvādaśamaṃḍale | trailokyadahanīdevī sā ca mūrttistrayodaśī || 23 || sṛṣṭisthiti ca saṃhāre anākhyākhye mahākrame | bhāsākhye guhyakālī ca nirvvāṇeśī pareśvarī || 24 || jhaṃkāriṇī bhairavī ca svarṇakoṭeśvarī śivā | rājarājeśvarī caṇḍā aghoreśī niśeśvarī || 25 || sundarī tripurā padmā tārā pūrṇeśvarī jayā | kramamaṇḍalamadhyasthā krameśī kubjikāmbikā || 26 || jyeṣṭhabālavibhevena kubjākṣyā ugracaṇḍikā | brahmāṇī raudrī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī dīrghanāsikā || 27 || vajrinī carccikā lakṣmīḥ pūjayeddivyamātaraḥ | aśitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodhīśo marttasaṃjñakau || 28 || kapālī bhīṣaṇīkhyaśca saṃhāraścaṣṭamastathā | bhaktānāṃ sādhakānāṃ ca lakṣmī siddhiṃ prayacchati || 29 ||
siddhilakṣmīrmmahādevī bhairaveṇānukīrttitā | sādhakā dveṣṭakāṣāñca sarvvakarmmavibhañjanī || 30 || viparītakarīdevī pratyaṃgirā namostute | kālādigrasate sarvvagrahabhūtādi ḍādinīḥ || 31 || sādhakaṃ rakṣate devī kālasaṅkarṣaṇī numaḥ | śivaṃ prayacchate devī rakṣate līlayā jagat | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi acintitārthasiddhaye || 32 || rājya lābhapradāṃ devīṃ rakṣaṇīṃ bhaktavatsalāṃ | pratyaṃgirā namasyāmi acintitārthasiddhaye || 33 || sarvvaśatrun pramarddantīṃ duritakleśanāśinīṃ | pratyaṃgi namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradāṃ || 34 || āpadambhodhitaraṇiṃ paraṃnirvvāṇadāyinīṃ | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmī jayapradāṃ || 35 || rājyadāṃ dhanadāṃ lakṣmīṃ mokṣadāṃ duḥkhanāśinīṃ | pratyaṅgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradāṃ || 36 ||
duṣṭaśatrupraśamanīṃ mahāvyādhivināśinīṃ | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradāṃ || 37 || kaliduḥsvapnapraśamanīṃ mahotpātavināśinīṃ | pratyaṅgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradāṃ || 38 || acintyasiddhidāṃ dhātrīṃ cintitārthaphalapradāṃ | pratyaṅgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradāṃ || 39 || rājopasarggaśamanīṃ mṛtyupradravanāśinīṃ | pratyaṅgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradāṃ || 40 || rājamātāṃ rājalakṣmīṃ rājeṣṭaphaladāyinīṃ | pratyaṅgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ namāmyahaṃ || 41 || siddhilakṣmīrmmahāvidyā mahāsiddhipradāyikā | paṭhedvā pāṭhayedvāpi stotraṃ pratyaṃgirābhidhaṃ || 42 || paṭhanācchatru sainyādi stambhayadbhañjayet kṣaṇāt |
acintitāni siddhyanti paṭhanāt siddhimāpnuyāt || 43 || mahādoṣapraśamanaṃ mahāvyādhivināśanaṃ | siṃhavyāghragrahabhayarājopadravanāśanaṃ || 44 || grahapīḍā jalāgnīnāṃ nāśanaṃ devi śāntidaṃ | pūjākālamahāstotraṃ ye paṭhiṣyanti sādhakāḥ || 45 || teṣāṃ siddhirnnadūresti devyāḥ devyāḥ saṃtuṣṭidāyakaṃ | tannāsti yanna siddhye te kaulike kulaśāsana || 46 || yaṃ yaṃ cintayate kāmaṃ sasasiddhyati līlayā | satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi kaulike tatsamo na hi || 47 || arddharātre samutthāya dīpaḥ prajvālite niśi | paṭhyate stotra metantu sarvvasiddhyati cintitaṃ || 48 || punaścaryyāṃ vinānena stotrapāṭhena siddhyati | maṇḍale pratimāgre vā maṇḍalāgre paṭhedyadi || 49 || idaṃ proktaṃ mahāstotramacintitārthasiddhidaṃ | anyadevaratānāntu na dayantu kadācana || 50 ||
dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya kuladīkṣāratāya ca | anyathā patanaṃ yānti ityājñāparameśvarī || 51 ||
iti śrītridaśaḍāmare karavīre śrīsiddhināthāvatāritaḥ śrisiddhilakṣmīmantrānuvṛddhistavaḥ samāptaḥ ||
trikhaṇḍādaṇḍakamūlayā || aiṁ (5) jaya jaya jagadambe praṇati harihare hiraṇye garbha suramukuṭa mandāramālā parimalamiladalapatavā vālacarana puṇḍarīka puṇḍarīkākṣakaṇakāmbu vimalamandākinī suradiṃdu kuṇḍāravindusaṃdohasundarī sarīra prabhe suprabhe jaya jaya mahākāli kālanāśinī samayacakramelāpinī siddhigaṇayoginī viravidyādhara jananī suramuninamitaṃ varanitaṃvinī kadambakinnarairārādhyamānā kevārā vidhānā siddhilakṣmī prade virūpākṣa cakṣu
śravānandadāyike tribhuvananāyike sphuradanarghamaṇimuktābali karadyotāsthi cakṣu vā nandabharaṇa ṛṇa ṛṇāyamānī taruvallī vahalapāṭali kṛtasakala digmaṇḍalaguṇusthala lalita raviśaśi kuṇḍasamanvite pīnakaṭhinakucakalaśayugala valilata naramuṇḍāvalimaṇḍite caṇḍī rūdhirapānapramatta pretakala kalorttāna vetālakacatālikāṇḍa vanatāṇḍava pramukhadṛḍhaḍākinīcakre caṃkramanacakita cintācaya camatkāra visphutita piśācavaya citkāradhvanimukhara kanaviraśmaśānavāsinī rudraskaṃḍādhirūḍhe ṣaḍādhāramadhvāravinda mandiroharā kucanomnitaṃ paśuptabhujagāyamānakulanī śaktiprabhā pradīpīkā vidyātita śūkṣmīṇā savale vikasitākāśa śaśimaṇḍalāmṛtadhārādhāraṇī
payonidhi sadṛśī mahā ṛddhipradāyanī akhila sādhārakārya narubhāvite subhāvite mātṛkācakra sakalālite mṛgākuṅkumā gurumṛgamandaparāgaparimūlāvāsite vasanaparimaṇḍite khaṇḍendu maṇḍite jaṭākalāpakalitakanavīradāmakahlāre kanakakeṭakī navamallikā madantikā mādhyavividhagaṃdhavaharaparibhūṣite vividhavidyādhara suranaranāgakiṃnaragaṇa dhyāyamāne trinayanācale jayatu jayagajjananī jayajaya navākṣarī narurutyādhika dviśatākṣarī mantramalādhidevatī kāli kātyāyanī kāpālinī nararudhiravasāpiśitaparipūrṇā kāpālakapāladhārinī kalavāla triśūla khaṭvāṅga ghaṇṭā muṇḍa pāśāṃkuśa varābhaya sobhita
daśabhujāvadhāriṇī varddha virāsana siddheśvarī akhilamunijavaṃdyamānāṃ kamalāṃghriśāmbhava vaiśavaibhavadevī amākhya umākhya sadā pūrṇamākṣala sarttārakākhye akāra kṣakāra sphurada malamanākāle mahāvyogni vyomavāceśvarī kubjīkā khecarī gocarī bhucari digambarī samvarī śakticakrayacchājñānarūpe guṇātīta nityāmṛtya nṛtyabhogapadasaṃdhyavasāna samayalāsya vilāsya ṭaṃ ṭaṃ mahānaṭakūtha parivārita nṛtyanāyaki sakalakāvya kalākalāpavala triguṇabandhavividhavaṃdha śuddharapravāhite sīddhi ṛddhibuddhijñānamāna sārade ṣodaśākṣarī catuḥstriṃśākṣarī śitakusumalamilita madhukaramukhala dhvaniparisara vipine maṇḍala tāṇḍavī tatkuṇḍalī vipakṣa pakṣa vipakṣa pavanapari

dhari dudu kasti arghatrodaka || navadravya (9) || gaṃgājala || thvate choṅa vīradravyena vāraṃhtyāya || sarvvadvayake trikoṇa śivaśakti saha || gherayitālate || kṣecala bhūcala jalacala sekhera sarvvacaru aṇḍaja arddhapāka kaṃca samayāntaka bhaṃḍālasathaṃne || triyāñjali (3) || bali || āvāhanādi mudrā || astrena visarjjanaṃ || dūṃte || cakrasavoya || ete nidhāya || kumbhasa trikoṇa aiṁkāragarbhaṃ likhyete śivaśakti saha bhāṇḍe dhūpayet || gurusyaṃ kuṃbhajoṅāvadevasosyaṃcone || yoginisyaṃ alisaṃpūrṇaṃ yāṅathanne gurusya paḍape varṇāntoyaṃtyādi || śivaśaktiṃ (2) thaṃne thava (2) thāyasate || pūjāmaṇḍape nidhāya || samayāntaka tadagre nidhāya || śivaśakti gururagre nidhāya ||
seveyāya yoginī ādina || padape || kṣīrārṇava samadbhūtaṃ koṅkaṇe yat prakāsitaṃ | sahajānandasandohaṃ nirmmitaṃ paramāmṛtaṃ || varṇānāñca sarvveṣāñca mekīkavarṇamuttamaṃ | kulasāsano sidhyarthaṃ annapātraṃ pragṛhyatā || seveyaṃ paramā vidyā seveyaṃ paramākalā | seveyaṃ paramāśakti gṛhīta kaulikeśvarā || carusakaleṃ nāpācchyāṅāva yoginī ādina sagaṇaṃ visyahe || surā ||
puṣpabhājanayāya || yathā devasya stotra || tritatvana ācamana || arghādi || sūryyārgha || vīrajanapādaprakṣālana || vacāṃ priyaṃ gusurabhīrabhī uśīlaṃ candanaṃ tathā | vālamāṃsī tathācora sanabhāgāni kārayet ||
tato kāli yoginī pūjā || gurunamaskāra || yathāmnāya nyāsa ||
jalapātra arghapātra bhūtaśuddhi ātmapūjā || āsana || ādhāraśaktetyādi (8) || ceta || ai vilepanaṃ pādukāṃ || śrīkhaṇḍa caṇḍanaṃ divyaṃ gandhādya sumanoharaṃ | ābhūṣaṇaṃ lalātākhya candanaṃ parigṛhyatāṃ ||
siṃdūrayā || hrīṁ vīrabhasmaṃ pādukāṃ || vīreśvari mahāvīra vīrabhasma vibhūṣitaṃ | trailokyākarṣṣanīdevī siṃdūrāruṇamuttamaṃ ||
mohanī || śrīsarvvajanamohanī pādukāṃ || mohanaṃ kāmasaṃsiddhistambhādyākarjjalastathā || ajalaṃ cakṣasaubhāgyaṃ mohanaṃ dṛṣṭi dāyakaṃ ||
jajamakā || hsphreṁ jajñopavītaṃ pādukāṃ || jajñopavītaṃ paramaṃ pavitra prajāpateja sahajaṃ pustā āyukṣamagraṃ prathamaṃ ca sūtraṃ yajñopavītaṃ paramastuteja ||
svāna || hsauṁ nānāchatra alaṃkāva puṣpaṃ pādukāṃ || nānāpuṣpasugaṃdhāni mālāḍyāṃ kusumodaya | saubhāgyasiddhidaṃ bhadre puṣpārohanamuttamaṃ ||
dṛṣṭi || dhvajā || vastrādi || siṃdhralaṃṅa || kauṣeyakau saṃbhavikāravarṇa hiraṇyavarṇānya vipīta raktaṃ | sobhāḍhya vastraṃ varade ca tubhyaṃ gṛhānadevi pradadāni tubhyaṃ ||
pūjana || hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ navākṣara saptadaśīnaṃ || bali || dhūpa dīpa jāpa āvāhanādi yonimudrāṃ || samaya || pātra hlāya || aiṁ carukaṃ gṛhnate devi siddhānāmanimoditaṃ | lokopakārarthāya nirmmalaṃ phatikopamaṃ || rasāyano hi sarvvasya devāte paṃca nirmmitaṃ || niḥkalaṃ sakalotpannaṃ kamalapastha namāmyahaṃ || gṛhna vīra imaṃ dhammaṃ siddhānāmanumoditaṃ | brahmakṣetriya cāṇḍālamekakālaṃ namāmyahaṃ ||
svāgataṃ dharmmarājānāṃ maparāga vivarjjitaṃ | dveṣādveśavinirmmuktaṃ tatvekaṃ nirmmitaṃ tvayā || baliṃ gṛhna mahāvīra carunaivedya sādhanaṃ | niḥkalaṃ sakalotpannaṃ padmapatraṃ namāmyahaṃ || siṃdūra dakṣiṇā || aiṁ (3) khphreṁ siṃdūrachatravaravandana puṣpamālā yajñopavīta vasanījana dhūpadīpa || tāṃbūlamodakaphalāniśi arccanena etāni sarvvaracitā paripūritāni || pratyaṃgirā prabhṛti devagaṇāśca sarvva saṃpūjitā phalamidaṃ śriyaṃ saṃpadāni || śānti sadā bhavatu maṃgala dehalakṣmī nirvvighna jāgakuru vīrajanasya siddhaṃ | asmākaṃ puṇyalokānāṃ śiva bhavatu sarvvadā ||
yā sā bhedā tribhedā paramapadagatā candraśīlāsanasthā brahmāviṣṇuśca rudra sakalapakṣimaśaubhūta nitya śaraṇyā | śaktyā sā sarvvaśubho vanamṛga hariṇā cāpahasteṣu bāṇaṃ
śyāmāraktāruṇāṃgī praṇamatiśatataṃ siddhi gaurīśanāthaḥ ||
yā devī caṇḍakālī kramakula sakalā maṇḍalasthaṇḍilaṃ vā kṣetro pīṭhopapīṭhe sagaṇagurubhṛtā yoginī vīravṛnde || devaḥ śrīsiddhinātha jaya na parividhi dīpajāgādikeṣu vighnātaṃ śāpamuktaṃ abhimata phaladā rājyalakṣmī sadātā ||
atra gaṃdhādi || thvate yoginīpūjā ||
tridevapūjā (3) || āsana || ādhāraśaktetyādi (8) || narāsanāya pādukāṃ || mayūrāsanā dukāṃ || muṃsāsanāya pādukāṃ || pūrvvavat candanādi || triyāñjali || kṣāṁ kṣīṁ kṣūṁ kṣatrapālāya pādukāṃ (3) || baliḥ ||
śrīṁ hrīṁ kulaputravaṭukanāthāya pādukāṃ || (3) baliḥ || gāṁ gīṁ gūṁ kulagaṇeśvarāya pādukāṃ (3) || baliḥ || ṣaḍaṃga || pātrahlāya pūrvvavat śloka ||
stotra || vande sadā sakalakolikasārabhūtaṃ kṣetreśvaraṃ narakapālaka tāmbamālaṃ | khaṭvāṅgakhaḍgavare pheṭakakādyahastaṃ dvāre sthitaṃ tribhuvaneśvara vallabhāyā ||
śrīsāsane vaṭukanātha iti prasiddha skandasurārijanakonana dhumaketu | gaurīsutaḥ śagati mujvalitā dadhānāṃ yāyāt surakte vaśanā śikhivāhanovaḥ ||
siṃdūrasāṃdramaramocchita raktakumbho nirjjirghanā gaṇapayodhana deha lakṣmī | vibhratkuṭhāravaramodaka sākṣasūtraṃ pāyādvayaṃ gaṇapati sakarārtha dātā ||
yathāvāna || dakṣiṇā || atra gaṃdhādi || nirvvighnaṃ prayāntu || (2) || siddheśvara pūjā || āsana || pūrvvavat ādhāraśaktetyādi (8) || vṛṣāsanāya pādukāṃ || siṃhāsanāya pādukāṃ || pūrvvavat candanādi ||
triyāñjali || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hsphreṁ hsauṁ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandabhairava siddheśvara śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi || (3) || bali || ṣaḍaṃga || mudrā || pūrvvavat pātrahlāya ||
stotra || ekāsyā trilocana khandedu kṛtaśeṣarā | catuhastā mahesāni dvayahasta kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
yathāvāna || dakṣiṇā || atra gandhādi || nirvighnaṃ prayāntu || thvate siddheśvara pūjā ||
tato siddhilakṣmī || āsana || pūrvvavat ādhāraśaktetyādi || khphreṁ rudrapretāsanāya pādu candanādi || triyāñjali || oṃ hrīṁ hūṁ hāṁ pheṁ kṣoṁ kroṁ namaḥ svāhāḥ pādukāṃ (3) || baliḥ ṣaḍaṃga || mudrā || pūrvvavat pātrahlāya ||
stotra || utphullāmbuja karṇikoparigatā śrīsiddhilakṣmī parā karpūrasphaṭikendu kunda dhavarā niḥsekha pāsepahā | saṃsārārṇavaduḥkhapaṅkalaharī niṣkaṃpanaṃ sarvvadā śrīmatpañcamukhāmbujā daśabhujā preta sthitā pātuva ||
yathāvāna || dakṣiṇā || atra gandhādi || nirvighnaṃ prayāntu || thvate siddhilakṣmīpūjā || (4) ||
thaṃdiri saradātmāpūjā || ādhāraśaktetyādi || padmāsanāya pādukāṃ || narāsanāya pādukāṃ || candanādi || triyāñjali || (5) hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda vīrādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ śrīnavātmāgurumaṇḍalabhaṭṭārikāya pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || ṣaḍaṃga || mudrā || pātrahlāya ||
stotra || ukāro mṛtyupādo hasakṣamalabhujo bodharaścāgni liṃgaṃ vāyuvyāghrājināke śaśi sakarayutaṃ bindunādorddhayukto | nirjigaṃgāmbudhārā rijuparamakalā bhairavo mantramūrtti pāyādevo navātmā sakaraguruvaraṃ bhairavaḥ śrīkujeśa ||
yathāvāna || dakṣiṇā || atra gandhādi || nirvvighnaṃ prayāntu || thvate navātmāpūjā || (5) ||
tato pañcabalipūjā || ādhāraśaktetyādi (8) || mayusanāya pādukāṃ || narāsanāya pādukāṃ || savāsanāya pādukāṃ || pretāsanāya pādukāṃ || mūsāsanāya pādukāṃ || candanādi || triyāñjali || śrīṁ hrīṁ kulaputravaṭukanāthāya pādukāṃ || kṣāṁ kṣīṁ kṣuṁ kṣetrapālāya pādukāṃ || yāṁ yīṁ yūṁ yoginībhyo pādukāṃ || hskhphreṁ śrīsiddhicāmuṇḍeśvarī pādukāṃ || gāṁ gīṁ gūṁ śrīkulagaṇeśvarāya pādukāṃ || thava (2) naṃ bali || ṣaḍaṃga || āvāhanādi || svasvamudrā || pātrahlāya ||
stotra || gauryāputraṃ kumāraṃ gagaṇaśaśi nibhaṃ kṣetrakaṃ yoginiñca cāmuṇḍā caṇḍarūpā dviravapati mukhaṃ vighnahāraṃ gaṇeśaḥ | puṣpādyā dhūpadīpāmikhamadhu balibhiḥ carccitā bhūṣitāṅgī cakresaṃpūjitānāṃ vighini duritaharaṃ bhuktimuktindadātu ||
yathāvāna dakṣiṇā || atra gandhādi ||
nirvvighnaṃ prayāṃtu || thvate pañcabalipūjā || (6) ||
svāmnāya devyārccanaṃ || āsana || ādhāraśaktetyādi (8) mālakva āsana || candanādi || triyāñjali mālako || bali thvanaṃ || ṣaḍaṅga || āvāhanādi || mudrā || pātrahlāya || stotra mālakva || yathāvāna || dakṣiṇā || atra gandhādi || nirvighnaṃ prayāntu || thvate svāmnāya devyārccanaṃ || (7) ||
agnikuṇḍa sakarmmapūjā || ādhāraśaktetyādi || āsana mālakva || candanādi || triyāñjali || hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda vīrādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ aṣṭāviśatikarmmabhaṭṭārikāya pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || ṣaḍaṃga || āvāhanādi || mudrā || pātrahlāya ||
stotra || madhyatrisrāsanasthā madamuditamukhī vajrapadmo sudīptaṃ brahmādyaṣṭapatre suradigapraṇame śrīprayāgādi kṣetre | yuktāṣṭāviṃśakoṣṭe vaśaṣaśa hasakhe vajraśṛṅge sphuranti
sāṣṭāviṃśā tribhedakramakulanugatā pātu dvātriṃśavarṇā ||
yathāvāna || dakṣiṇā || atra gandhādi || nirvvighnaṃ prayāntu || (8) || thvate aṣṭāviṃsati ||
tato śikhānāthapūjanaṃ || ādhāraśaktetyādi (8) || vṛṣāsanāya pādukāṃ || pañcapretāsanāya pādukāṃ || pūrvvavat candanādi puṣpa || pūjana || (5) aghore hrāṁ thaghore hrīṁ gharaghorantare hrūṁ phreṁ sarvvataḥ sarvva sarvve hreṁ juṁ saḥ hrāṁ rudrarūpe hra pādukāṃ || hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda vīrādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ pādukāṃ || hsphrāṁ hsphrīṁ hsphrūṁ śikhāsvachandamahābhairavāya pādukāṃ || (3) || bali || ṣaḍaṃga || āvāhanādimudrā || pūrvvavat pātrasamayajoṅāvayaḍaye || carukaṃ gṛhnate vītyādi || dvekhyā dvekhya vinimuktaṃ tatve kena vicintvayā || thanā vākyakāyāva pātra hlāya || baliviya
baliviya || samastamantrapīṭhityādi || bali gṛhna mahāvīra ityādi padmapatraṃ namāmyahaṃ || thanā siṃdūra dakṣinā || sidūra caṃdana viretyādi ||
stotra || śuddhaśāntaṃ saśubhraṃ sphaṭikamaṇimayaṃ bhūta karppūrakānti pañcāsyaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ dharati daśabhujaṃ śūlaśastrāstrakaṃ ca || hāḍaṃ divyāṅgabhūṣaṃ trinayana dahanaṃ sarppajajñopavītaṃ devo svacchandamūrtti sakalabhayaharaṃ naumi nāthaṃ śikhesaḥ ||
pāṇau brahmakapālamujvalatale kaṇṭhe murāre vapu sarvvāṅge tu tuṣārahāladhavarā devoṣṭhimālā dhṛtaṃ | vibhracchulaprasālarodhanabhayo bhūyoti saṃbhūtayaḥ pāyādva parayāvasāna samaya kāpāliko śaṃṅkaraḥ ||
yathāvāna || dakṣiṇā || atra gandhādi || nirvvighnaṃ prayāntu || (9) || thvate gaṇapūjā ||
tato sagaṇasyaṃ devārccanaṃ kārayet ||
thava degurikhāṅāvayāya || tritatvena ācamana || adyādi || sūryyārgha || gurunamaskāra || nyāsa || jalārghapātra bhūtaśuddhi ātmapūjā ||
tato māranī paṭhet || paṃcabali dadyāt || hṅathvani || lithva thava || jāpa stotra || gauryyāputraṃ tyādi || tarppaṇa ||
śrīsaṃvarttāna āvāhana || trideva (3) || thanā candrasūrya dvayo kumbhapūjāyāya || śiva || padmāsanāya pādukāṃ || aśitāṃgādi (8) || aghora || hskṣmlvryūṁ kulakumbhabhaṭṭārikāya alimuttaye pādukāṃ ||
śakti || siṃhāsanāya pādukāṃ || brahmāṇyādi (8) || vajra || śkṣmlvryīṁ kulakumbhabhaṭṭārikāya pādukāṃ || ṣaḍaṃga || thvate dvayo kumbhapūjā ||
sāṅgopāṅga deguliyāya || dhūpadīpa || jāpa || stotra || dhunake || sagaṇasyaṃ yoginīsake ājñākāya || aiṁ ājñāprasāda guruṇāṃ gaṇayogacakramājñā prasādamapinā gaṇasiddhilakṣmī | ājñāprasāda sagaṇaṃ gaṇadevatāyā ājñāprasāda kuru me mama dadi dehi || sagaṇasyaṃ ājñā (3) dhāya || bheruṃ(?)raṃṅanaphiya hāḍābharaṇanatiya aduvāra ābharaṇanakokhāya ||
carupūjāyāṅahaya || thaṇḍilayāhṅavane ||
adyādi sūryyārgha || vākya || gurunamaskārādi || mūlena nyāsa || jalārghapātra bhūtaśuddhi ātmapūjā ||
tribali || gāyatryābhyutakṣaṇaṃ || mahāpātrapūjā || aiṁ ādhāraśakti kamalāsanāya namaḥ || tadupari || niraṃjana kamalāsanāya namaḥ || pātrāsana ṣaḍaṅgapūjā || raṃ agnimaṇḍalāya daśadharmmakalātmane namaḥ ||
vaṁ sūryyamaṇḍala dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ || glūṁ slūṁ plūṁ mlūṁ nlūṁ paramāmṛta arghapātrāya pādukāṃ || pañcaratnaṃ pūjayāmi || dravya || vaṃdhūkarucirābhāsāṃ sugadhaṃ vādamoditāṃ | tadravyaparamaṃ devi ṛddhi siddhi pradāyinī || aiṁ hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ navākṣara pātraṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru kuru svāhā trikuṭīmudrāṃ || aghorāstrena prakṣālayet || aiṁ (5) vaṃ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ ||
aṃ amṛtādi ṣodaśakalātmane namaḥ ||
dhyāna || lākṣārasanibhādevī javādāḍimbarāginī | yauvanāntarūpāṃgī trinetra navayauvanī || madirānanda cetanyā bhujāṣṭādaśadhāriṇī | khaḍga triśūla vajraṃ ca diṇḍimaṃ mudgaraṃ tathā || gadā padma paraṃ pātraṃ dakṣiṇena virājataṃ | pheṭakāṃkuśaghaṃṭhā ca muṇḍakhaṭvāṃga kuṃbhayo || nilotpalabhayaṃ bindu vāmahaste virājate | divyaratnahutātopa hemālaṃkārabhūṣitā || śvetapadmāsanā devi vaddhapadmāsana sthitā || evaṃ rūpā mahādevī vāruṇī divyarūpiṇī | kramena siddhidaṃ devī kriyāśakti samaṃvite | saṃsevyate mahāvidyā prāyaścittādi śodhanī || mahāśāntīkarī devī sarvvavyādhirujāpahāṃ || evaṃ siddhikarī devī pātrapūjā mahāphalaṃ ||
na (9) || sa (17) || rjjhrīṁ mahācaṇḍateja saṃkarṣaṇi kāli manthānehaḥ || caṇḍa (17) ||
hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ || thanā ṣaḍaṃga || oṃ paramahaṃsinī nyāsādi || aiṁ (5) hlīṁ lrūṁ ratnalokabhogagarbhagāminī anantaloka amṛtasaṃcāriṇī anantānandadeva anantāmbā anantalakṣakoṭiyoginī śrīpādukāṃ || āvāhanādi trikhaṇḍāmudrā || bali stotra ||
kādyaṃ vidyāripūrṇā paramamṛtamayaṃ raktasiṃdūravarṇā sā devī divyarūpā suravarasagaṇā vanditā lokapālā || sā sṛṣṭi sṛṣṭiheto sakalasuragaṇāstoṣayaṃti sa devī saubhāgyaṃ divya toyaṃ abhimata phaladā mokṣalakṣmī sadātā ||
thvate mahāpātrapūjā || khecara || aiṁ (5) viśuddhi cakrāya namaḥ || khecarayā || prasastaṃ khecaraṃ deva ṭiṭṭibhādiṣu khecaraṃ | khecaraśrīyamuktaṃ ca khecarajanma na vidyate ||
pūjā || aiṁ ymlvryūṁ mahāsiddhikhecara śrīpādukāṃ ||
dhyāna || nīlaṃśugānanaṃ deva caturbbāhu trilocanaṃ | triśūla jāpyamālāṃ ca viśvāmitrapūrī mṛtaṃ || khageśavara samārūḍhā viśuddhi cakrasasthitā || dhyātvā tu khecaraṃ devaṃ lakṣmī saubhāgyadāyakaṃ || aiṁ (3) vāgeśvarī glūṁ ratnagagalokabhogagarbhagāminī gaganaloka amṛtasaṃcāriṇī gagaṇānandadeva gagambā catuḥṣaṣṭhilakṣakoṭisiddhi catuḥṣaṣṭhi yoginī pādukāṃ ||
candradvīpaviniḥkrāntaṃ jyotiṣmantaṃ suśobhanaṃ || ajñāvijñānadaṃ siddhi kuṇḍalīśaṃ namostute || aiṁ (5) chāṁ chīṁ mahantārikāyai hrīṁ glūṁ kalādhi sāṁ sīṁ sūṁ smlvryūṁ viśuddha śākiṇīprabhṛtī śrīkhaḍgīśānandadeva śrī || glūṁ khecaramūrttaye baliṃ gṛhna (2) svāhā || bali || saṃkṣobhanīmudrāṃ || ymlvryūṁ svāhā (10) || jāpa ||
khecaraṃ siddhidaṃ bhadre sarvvasaṃpatpradāyakaṃ | mokṣa lakṣmī sadā dehi īśvaroyaṃ namostute ||
